definition_en: A supreme being who is believed to have created and controls the world.
example_en: The most frequently used name for the Islamic god is Allah.
example_uz: Islom dinida Xudoning eng ko'p ishlatiladigan nomi Allohdir.

definition_en: A place of suffering where evil people go after they die.
example_en: My new boss is making my job a living hell.
example_uz: Yangi boshlig'im ishimni haqiqiy azobga aylantirib qo'ydi.

definition_en: An expression used to show surprise or to tell someone to stop.
example_en: Whoa, are you really planning to travel across the country alone?
example_uz: Oho, haqiqatan ham butun mamlakat bo'ylab yolg'iz sayohat qilmoqchimisan?

definition_en: To breathe out loudly to express sadness, tiredness, or relief.
example_en: She sighs deeply when she looks at all the unfinished work.
example_uz: U tugallanmagan ishlarga qarab chuqur xo'rsinib qo'ydi.

definition_en: Satisfactory or in an acceptable condition.
example_en: It is alright if you finish the homework tomorrow instead of today.
example_uz: Uyga vazifani bugun emas ertaga tugatsang ham mayli.

definition_en: To be unable to do something.
example_en: I cannot open this heavy box because it is locked tight.
example_uz: Bu og'ir qutini ocha olmayapman, chunki u mahkam qulflangan.

definition_en: The sound of someone laughing quietly to themselves.
example_en: I could hear soft chuckles coming from the back of the room.
example_uz: Xonaning orqa tomonidan mayin kulgi ovozlarini eshitdim.

definition_en: A polite and formal way to refer to a group of men.
example_en: The gentlemen waited patiently for the meeting to start on time.
example_uz: Janoblar yig'ilish o'z vaqtida boshlanishini sabr bilan kutishdi.

definition_en: A person whom you love very much, often used to address them.
example_en: Please pass me the salt, darling, it is right next to you.
example_uz: Jonim, iltimos, tuzni uzatib yuboring, u aynan yoningizda.

definition_en: A word you say to someone when you are leaving or they are leaving.
example_en: It is time for me to go now, goodbye everyone, see you.
example_uz: Endi ketishim kerak, xayr hammaga, ko'rishguncha.

definition_en: Saying something that is not true as a joke to be funny.
example_en: I was only kidding when I said I would quit my job.
example_uz: Ishdan bo'shayman deganimda shunchaki hazillashgan edim.

definition_en: To become the husband or wife of someone in a legal ceremony.
example_en: They decided to marry after knowing each other for five years.
example_uz: Ular besh yil tanish bo'lganlaridan so'ng turmush qurishga qaror qilishdi.

definition_en: To make a very serious promise that you are telling the truth.
example_en: The knight swore not to return until he had found the treasure.
example_uz: Ritsar xazinani topmagunicha qaytmaslikka qasam ichdi.

definition_en: A person who behaves in a very stupid way.
example_en: Only an idiot would fail to check the answers on this exam.
example_uz: Faqat ahmoq odamgina imtihondagi javoblarni tekshirmaydi.

definition_en: A very unpleasant, unkind, or rude person.
example_en: Some bastard stole my bike while I was inside the shop.
example_uz: Men do'konda bo'lganimda bir iflos velosipedimni o'g'irlab ketibdi.

definition_en: Making a very loud, sharp, and high noise.
example_en: The children were screaming with excitement at the birthday party.
example_uz: Tug'ilgan kun bazmida bolalar quvonchdan qichqirib yuborishdi.

definition_en: A child's word for their mother.
example_en: I am going to visit my mum this weekend for dinner.
example_uz: Bu hafta oxiri kechki ovqatga onamnikiga boraman.

definition_en: A way for young children to say mother.
example_en: The baby reached out his small hands for his mama.
example_uz: Chaqaloq kichkina qo'llarini onasiga uzatdi.

definition_en: A low-ranking officer in the army or a helpful assistant to someone.
example_en: The lieutenant followed the general's orders during the difficult mission.
example_uz: Leytenant qiyin topshiriq vaqtida generalning buyruqlarini bajardi.

definition_en: Covered with or full of blood.
example_en: He had a bloody nose after falling down in the street.
example_uz: Ko'chada yiqilib tushgandan keyin burni qonab qoldi.

definition_en: A male romantic partner whom you are dating.
example_en: I was playing the drums and my boyfriend was playing the guitar.
example_uz: Men barabanda chalar edim, yigitim esa gitara chalardi.

definition_en: The sound or act of laughing because something is funny.
example_en: Their loud laughter betrayed their presence in the quiet room.
example_uz: Ularning baland kulgisi sokin xonada borligini fosh qildi.

definition_en: A polite way to address a woman in a formal setting.
example_en: Would madam like to order some tea and cake now?
example_uz: Xonim, hozir choy va tortga buyurtma berasizmi?

definition_en: To make a short, low sound in the throat, often when annoyed.
example_en: He grunts when he has to lift the heavy boxes.
example_uz: Og'ir qutilarni ko'tarishi kerak bo'lganda u g'ingshirab qo'yadi.

definition_en: A high-ranking officer in the army or air force.
example_en: The colonel led his soldiers into the training base this morning.
example_uz: Polkovnik bugun ertalab askarlarini mashg'ulot bazasiga olib kirdi.

definition_en: To have to pay someone back or do something for someone.
example_en: I owe Kevin five dollars which he lent me last week.
example_uz: Men o'tgan hafta Kevin qarzga bergan besh dollarni qaytarishim kerak.

definition_en: The sister of your father or mother.
example_en: My aunt is coming to visit us for the weekend.
example_uz: Xolam dam olish kunlari biznikiga mehmon bo'lib kelyapti.

definition_en: To take a quick, sudden breath because of surprise, shock, or pain.
example_en: She gasps in surprise when she sees the gift on the table.
example_uz: Stoldagi sovg‘ani ko‘rgach, u hayratdan nafasini yutib yubordi.

definition_en: Something that is of very bad quality or that is not true.
example_en: I do not want to watch this movie because it is complete crap.
example_uz: Bu kinoni ko‘rishni xohlamayman, chunki u butunlay savsata.

definition_en: A person who tells a story, often in a book, movie, or documentary.
example_en: The narrator of the documentary has a very deep and calm voice.
example_uz: Hujjatli filmning hikoyachisi juda yo‘g‘on va xotirjam ovozga ega.

definition_en: To make a short low sound in the throat due to effort or pain.
example_en: The player kept grunting while he was lifting the heavy metal weights.
example_uz: O‘yinchi og‘ir temir toshlarni ko‘tarayotganda tinmay ingillardi.

definition_en: To or on a higher floor of a building.
example_en: I am going upstairs to get some sleep after this long day.
example_uz: Uzoq kundan keyin uxlab dam olish uchun yuqori qavatga chiqyapman.

definition_en: A non-commissioned military officer of a rank above corporal.
example_en: The sergeant gave clear instructions to all the soldiers in the unit.
example_uz: Serjant bo‘linmadagi barcha askarlarga aniq ko‘rsatmalar berdi.

definition_en: The sound of people clapping their hands to show they enjoyed something.
example_en: The audience gave a loud applause after the beautiful piano performance ended.
example_uz: Chiroyli pianino ijrosi tugagach tomoshabinlar qattiq qarsak chalishdi.

definition_en: The past tense of steal; to take something that is not yours.
example_en: Someone stole my bicycle while I was inside the shop buying food.
example_uz: Men do‘konda oziq-ovqat sotib olayotganimda kimdir velosipedimni o‘g‘irlab ketdi.

definition_en: To make a long, low sound because of pain, sadness, or unhappiness.
example_en: The old man groans every time he tries to stand up from sitting.
example_uz: Chol har safar o‘rnidan turishga uringanda ingrab qo‘yadi.

definition_en: A word for mother, used especially by young children.
example_en: The little girl ran to her mommy to show her new doll.
example_uz: Qizaloq yangi qo‘g‘irchog‘ini ko‘rsatish uchun oyijonisining oldiga yugurdi.

definition_en: Very silly or unreasonable; something that makes you want to laugh.
example_en: It is ridiculous to expect everyone to finish this huge task today.
example_uz: Hamma odam bu ulkan ishni bugun tugatishini kutish juda bema’nilik.

definition_en: The quality of being very impressive, grand, or powerful.
example_en: We were all amazed by the majesty of the snowy mountain peaks.
example_uz: Biz qorli tog' cho'qqilarining ulug'vorligidan hayratda qoldik.

definition_en: In the state of sleeping.
example_en: Please be quiet because the baby is finally asleep in the room.
example_uz: Iltimos, shovqin qilmang, chunki chaqaloq nihoyat xonada uxlayapti.

definition_en: A vulgar expression used to show strong anger or extreme frustration.
example_en: Goddamn! I forgot my keys inside the locked house again.
example_uz: La'nat! Kalitlarimni qulflangan uy ichida qoldirib ketibman.

definition_en: A person who is very kind or someone you love very much.
example_en: She is such a sweetheart for helping me carry these heavy bags.
example_uz: Bu og'ir sumkalarni ko'tarishga yordam bergani uchun u juda mehribon inson.

definition_en: A rude, mean, or very unpleasant person.
example_en: He acted like such an asshole by laughing at his friend's failure.
example_uz: U do'stining muvaffaqiyatsizligidan kulib, juda yaramas ish qildi.

definition_en: To ask someone for something in an urgent or very humble way.
example_en: The child had to beg his parents to let him go outside.
example_uz: Bola ota-onasidan tashqariga chiqishga ruxsat berishlarini yalinib so'radi.

definition_en: Loud happy shouts showing support or enjoyment of an event.
example_en: The crowd started cheering loudly when their team scored a goal.
example_uz: Jamoa gol urganida tomoshabinlar qattiq olqishlay boshlashdi.

definition_en: Any person at all; it does not matter who the person is.
example_en: Whoever wants to join the trip must sign the list today.
example_uz: Sayohatga qo'shilmoqchi bo'lgan har kim bugun ro'yxatga imzo cheksin.

definition_en: Ideas, statements, or beliefs that you think are completely false or silly.
example_en: I do not believe his story; it is total bullshit.
example_uz: Uning gaplariga ishonmayman; bu shunchaki safsata.

definition_en: The mother of your mother or father.
example_en: My grandma makes the best apple pie in the whole world.
example_uz: Buvim dunyodagi eng mazali olma pirogini pishiradi.

definition_en: Speaking very loudly because of anger or excitement.
example_en: I could hear the shouting coming from the next room.
example_uz: Keyingi xonadan kelayotgan baqiriqlarni eshitdim.

definition_en: To forgive someone for something they have done wrong.
example_en: The governor decided to pardon the prisoner after ten years.
example_uz: Gubernator o'n yildan so'ng mahbusni afv etishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: To take air into your lungs and let it out again.
example_en: It is difficult to breathe when the air is very dusty.
example_uz: Havo juda chang bo‘lganda nafas olish qiyinlashadi.

definition_en: Ideas, statements, or beliefs that are not true or have no meaning.
example_en: Stop talking such nonsense and tell me what really happened.
example_uz: Bunaqa bema’ni gaplarni yig‘ishtirib nima bo‘lganini rostini ayt.

definition_en: The father of your mother or your father.
example_en: My grandpa tells the best stories about his life long ago.
example_uz: Bobom yoshligi haqida juda qiziq hikoyalar aytib beradi.

definition_en: Used to say what you really think or to tell the truth.
example_en: Honestly, I think you should take a break from working today.
example_uz: Rostini aytsam bugun ishlashdan biroz dam olishing kerak deb o‘ylayman.

definition_en: An informal way to address a male friend or acquaintance.
example_en: Hey bro, do you want to come over and play games?
example_uz: Ey o‘rtoq uyga o‘tib o‘yin o‘ynaymizmi?

definition_en: A kind and affectionate way of addressing someone you love.
example_en: Don't cry, my sweetie, everything is going to be just fine.
example_uz: Yig‘lama jonim hammasi yaxshi bo‘ladi.

definition_en: An exclamation used to express great excitement, joy, or enthusiasm.
example_en: Whoo! We finally finished all our exams and can relax now.
example_uz: Ura! Nihoyat barcha imtihonlarni topshirib oldik, endi dam olsak bo‘ladi.

definition_en: A familiar or informal word for a father.
example_en: When I was a little child, my papa read me stories.
example_uz: Men kichkinaligimda dadam menga ertaklar o‘qib berardilar.

definition_en: The past tense of throw, meaning to send something through the air by hand.
example_en: He threw the ball across the field to his best friend.
example_uz: U to‘pni maydonning narigi tomonidagi eng yaqin do‘stiga otdi.

definition_en: A polite way of addressing a man when you do not use his name.
example_en: Excuse me, mister, you dropped your wallet on the sidewalk today.
example_uz: Kechirasiz, janob, siz hamyoningizni yo‘lakka tushirib yubordingiz.

definition_en: Not clear or easily seen, heard, or understood.
example_en: I could only hear an indistinct voice coming from the next room.
example_uz: Yon xonadan kelayotgan noaniq ovozni zo‘rg‘a eshitdim.

definition_en: To stop being visible or cease to exist suddenly.
example_en: The sun disappeared behind the thick clouds late this afternoon.
example_uz: Quyosh tushdan keyin qalin bulutlar ortiga yashirindi.

definition_en: Having an attractive and pleasing appearance, usually used to describe a man.
example_en: He is a very handsome man with a kind smile.
example_uz: U samimiy tabassumli juda kelishgan yigit.

definition_en: The past tense of sleep, resting your body and mind with eyes closed.
example_en: I slept for eight hours and feel very refreshed today.
example_uz: Men sakkiz soat uxladim va bugun o'zimni juda tetik his qilyapman.

definition_en: Showing a serious mental illness or acting in a wild, unreasonable way.
example_en: It would be absolutely insane to drive during this heavy storm.
example_uz: Bu kuchli bo'ronda mashina haydash mutlaqo aqlsizlik bo'lar edi.

definition_en: An informal way of saying no.
example_en: Are you going to the party? Nope, I am staying home.
example_uz: Kechaga borasanmi? Yo'q, uyda qolaman.

definition_en: A mild way to express surprise or excitement without using strong language.
example_en: Gosh, I did not realize that I caused so much trouble today.
example_uz: Voy, buncha muammo keltirib qo‘yganimni bilmay qolibman.

definition_en: Something that is completely damaged, destroyed, or no longer in a good condition.
example_en: We visited the ruined castle on the hill during our weekend trip.
example_uz: Dam olish kunlari tepalikdagi vayron bo‘lgan qasrni borib ko‘rdik.

definition_en: A casual way of saying out of, often used in spoken English.
example_en: I am outta here because I have finished all my work early.
example_uz: Men ketdim, chunki hamma ishimni erta tugatib qo‘ydim.

definition_en: Used to describe something that happens before another time or as a preference.
example_en: The sooner we start this project, the faster we will finish it.
example_uz: Loyiha ishini qancha tez boshlasak, shuncha tez tugatamiz.

definition_en: To feel sad or sorry about something that you did or failed to do.
example_en: I really regret not taking that job opportunity when it was offered.
example_uz: O‘sha ish taklif qilinganda qabul qilmaganimdan juda afsusdaman.

definition_en: To make a short, high sound, usually from a car horn or electronic device.
example_en: The taxi driver kept beeping his horn because of the heavy traffic.
example_uz: Yo‘l tirband bo‘lgani uchun taksi haydovchisi tinimsiz signal berdi.

definition_en: To shout very loudly, usually because you are angry, excited, or need attention.
example_en: Please stop yelling at me; I can hear you perfectly well now.
example_uz: Iltimos, menga baqirishni bas qil, seni yaxshi eshityapman.

definition_en: A person who has illegally and intentionally killed another human being.
example_en: The police finally caught the murderer after a very long investigation process.
example_uz: Uzoq davom etgan tergov jarayonidan so‘ng politsiya qotilni qo‘lga oldi.

definition_en: The quality of being kind, honest, and morally right.
example_en: She is known for her goodness and helping people in need.
example_uz: U o'zining ezguligi va muhtojlarga yordam berishi bilan tanilgan.

definition_en: To spoil something completely so that it cannot be used or enjoyed.
example_en: The heavy rain will ruin our plans for the picnic today.
example_uz: Kuchli yomg'ir bugungi piknik rejamizni barbod qiladi.

definition_en: A person who says things that are not true.
example_en: Nobody trusts a liar, so you must always tell the truth.
example_uz: Hech kim yolg'onchiga ishonmaydi, shuning uchun doim rostini gapirishing kerak.

definition_en: A person who steals things that belong to other people.
example_en: The thief took his phone while he was waiting for the bus.
example_uz: O'g'ri avtobus kutib turganida uning telefonini o'g'irlab ketdi.

definition_en: To replace a rude word in a recording with a high-pitched sound.
example_en: The television station had to bleep all the bad words during filming.
example_uz: Telekanal suratga olish vaqtida hamma yomon so'zlarni o'chirib tashlashi kerak edi.

definition_en: Heavily filled with something, making it look as if it might break.
example_en: We sat down to a groaning table full of traditional delicious food.
example_uz: Biz an'anaviy mazali taomlarga to'lib-toshib yotgan dasturxon atrofida o'tirdik.

definition_en: A polite way of addressing a woman, especially a married one.
example_en: Excuse me, madame, have you forgotten your umbrella at the counter?
example_uz: Kechirasiz xonim, soyaboningizni peshtaxtada qoldirib ketmadingizmi?

definition_en: To or on a floor of a building that is lower than where you are now.
example_en: I need to go downstairs to get some water from the kitchen.
example_uz: Oshxonadan suv olish uchun pastki qavatga tushishim kerak.

definition_en: To make someone feel suddenly afraid or worried.
example_en: The loud noise of the thunder began to scare the little child.
example_uz: Momaqaldiroqning baland ovozi yosh bolani qo'rqitib yubordi.

definition_en: A feeling of sadness because you feel sorry for someone else's bad situation.
example_en: I felt great pity for the stray dog wandering in the rain.
example_uz: Yomg'irda daydib yurgan daydi itga juda rahmim keldi.

definition_en: Feeling guilty or embarrassed because you did something wrong.
example_en: He felt ashamed of his behavior during the argument last night.
example_uz: U kechagi janjaldagi qiliqlaridan uyaldi.

definition_en: Not working properly or not achieving any helpful results.
example_en: This old map is useless because all the roads have been changed.
example_uz: Bu eski xarita foydasiz, chunki barcha yo'llar o'zgarib ketgan.

definition_en: To breathe quickly and loudly through the mouth, usually after heavy exercise.
example_en: The dog was panting after running fast in the park.
example_uz: It parkda yugurib kelgach, hansirab turgan edi.

definition_en: Good at learning and understanding things quickly and easily.
example_en: He came up with a clever solution to the difficult problem.
example_uz: U murakkab muammoga juda aqlli yechim topdi.

definition_en: To hit someone or something hard with your head.
example_en: The angry goat tried to butt the fence with its horns.
example_uz: Jahl chiqqan echki shoxlari bilan panjarani urib to‘qnashmoqchi bo‘ldi.

definition_en: Used when the people you are talking to are both the subject and the object.
example_en: You should not blame yourselves for what happened yesterday.
example_uz: Kecha sodir bo‘lgan ish uchun o‘zlaringizni ayblamasligingiz kerak.

definition_en: Something that is extremely unpleasant and makes you feel sick.
example_en: The kitchen was disgusting because it had not been cleaned for weeks.
example_uz: Oshxona bir necha hafta tozalanmagani uchun juda jirkanch holatda edi.

definition_en: To empty liquid waste from your body.
example_en: I need to find a restroom to piss before the long drive.
example_uz: Uzoq yo‘lga chiqishdan oldin hojatxonaga kirib olishim kerak.

definition_en: A person who behaves in a mean or unpleasant way towards others.
example_en: Stop being such a jerk and help me with these heavy bags.
example_uz: Bunchalik yomon odam bo‘laverma va og‘ir sumkalarni ko‘tarishga yordamlash.

definition_en: To react in an extreme way, usually because of worry or surprise.
example_en: I started to freak out when I realized I lost my passport.
example_uz: Pasportimni yo‘qotib qo‘yganimni bilgach, qattiq sarosimaga tushdim.

definition_en: Not sleeping; conscious and aware of what is happening around you.
example_en: Even though it was late, I stayed awake to finish my book.
example_uz: Kech bo‘lishiga qaramay, kitobimni tugatish uchun uyg‘oq qoldim.

definition_en: High moral standards and being worthy of great respect.
example_en: It was a great honour to meet the president in person.
example_uz: Prezident bilan shaxsan uchrashish men uchun katta sharaf edi.

definition_en: A small pond used for keeping and growing oysters.
example_en: The oysters are moved to the claire to develop better flavor.
example_uz: Ustritsalar mazaliroq bo'lishi uchun maxsus hovuzga ko'chiriladi.

definition_en: To stop being visible or to go somewhere that is unknown.
example_en: The magician made the rabbit disappear right in front of us.
example_uz: Sehrgar quyonni ko'z o'ngimizda g'oyib qilib yubordi.

definition_en: To click your teeth together because you are very cold.
example_en: It was so cold outside that my teeth began to chatter.
example_uz: Tashqarida shunchalik sovuq ediki, tishlarim taqir-taqir qila boshladi.

definition_en: To make a loud, high sound because you are hurt or scared.
example_en: She started to scream when she saw a spider on the wall.
example_uz: Devorda o'rgimchakni ko'rgach, u qichqirib yubordi.

definition_en: Extremely good, bad, or surprising; difficult to accept as true.
example_en: The view from the top of the mountain was absolutely unbelievable.
example_uz: Tog' cho'qqisidan ko'rinadigan manzara shunchaki aqlbovar qilmas edi.

definition_en: To show that you think something is silly or unworthy of serious attention.
example_en: He scoffs at the idea that climate change is a serious threat.
example_uz: U iqlim o'zgarishi jiddiy tahdid ekanligi haqidagi g'oyani masxara qiladi.

definition_en: Well-informed about and sensitive to social justice issues and racial inequality.
example_en: They are trying to be more woke regarding modern social issues.
example_uz: Ular zamonaviy ijtimoiy masalalarga nisbatan hushyorroq bo'lishga harakat qilmoqdalar.

definition_en: A person who introduces programs or gives information on radio or television.
example_en: The radio announcer introduced the guest speaker to the listening audience.
example_uz: Radio diktori mehmon ma'ruzachini tinglovchilarga tanishtirdi.

definition_en: At some unknown time in the future.
example_en: I hope to visit the ancient cities of Uzbekistan someday soon.
example_uz: Umid qilamanki, bir kun kelib O'zbekistonning qadimiy shaharlariga boraman.

definition_en: A title used for a French-speaking man, equivalent to Mister.
example_en: Good morning, Monsieur, how can I help you today?
example_uz: Xayrli tong, janob, bugun sizga qanday yordam bera olaman?

definition_en: Slices of bread that have been heated until they are brown and crunchy.
example_en: I usually have a piece of warm toast with butter for breakfast.
example_uz: Nonushtaga odatda sariyog‘ surilgan qotirilgan non yeyman.

definition_en: A thick coil or loop of rope, yarn, or wire held together by a tie.
example_en: She bought a large hank of wool to knit a warm sweater.
example_uz: U issiq sviter to‘qish uchun bir kalava jun xarid qildi.

definition_en: The past tense of blow, meaning to move air or be moved by air.
example_en: The strong wind blew all the autumn leaves off the trees.
example_uz: Kuchli shamol daraxtlardagi barcha kuzgi barglarni uchirib ketdi.

definition_en: The past participle form of eat, meaning to have consumed food.
example_en: I have already eaten dinner, so I am not hungry right now.
example_uz: Men kechki ovqatni yeb bo‘lganman, shuning uchun hozir qornim och emas.

definition_en: A special vehicle used to take sick or injured people quickly to a hospital.
example_en: When he had an accident, we immediately called for an ambulance.
example_uz: U baxtsiz hodisaga uchraganda, biz darhol tez yordam mashinasini chaqirdik.

definition_en: The young baby of a marsupial animal, especially a kangaroo.
example_en: The little joey jumped back into its mother's pouch for safety.
example_uz: Kichkina kanguru bolasi xavfsizlik uchun onasining xaltasiga sakrab kirdi.

definition_en: Unable to escape from a place or a difficult situation.
example_en: The miners were trapped underground after the tunnel collapse occurred yesterday.
example_uz: Konchilar tunnel qulab tushganidan keyin yer ostida qamalib qolishdi.

definition_en: Speaking or acting in a way that is not polite to others.
example_en: It is rude to talk while someone else is speaking to you.
example_uz: Birov sizga gapirayotganda gapini bo'lish — odobsizlik.

definition_en: A sign or piece of information that helps you solve a problem.
example_en: The detective found a vital clue at the scene of the crime.
example_uz: Detektiv jinoyat joyidan muhim ishora topdi.

definition_en: A word said at the end of a prayer to show agreement.
example_en: Everyone in the church bowed their heads and said amen together.
example_uz: Cherkvadagi hamma boshini egib birgalikda omin dedi.

definition_en: A type of beautiful flower that grows from a bulb.
example_en: She placed a white lily in a vase on the table.
example_uz: U stol ustidagi vazaga oq nilufar guli qo'ydi.

definition_en: A machine that moves people or goods up and down inside a building.
example_en: We took the elevator to the tenth floor of the building.
example_uz: Binoning o'ninchi qavatiga liftda chiqdik.

definition_en: A special title used when talking to or about a prince or princess.
example_en: The people bowed when his highness entered the grand room.
example_uz: Oliy hazratlari katta xonaga kirganda odamlar ta'zim qilishdi.

definition_en: At a time in the future or past that is not exactly known.
example_en: I hope we can visit that beautiful city sometime next year.
example_uz: Umid qilamanki, kelasi yili qachondir o'sha go'zal shaharga boramiz.

definition_en: Feeling very strong thirst and wanting a drink immediately.
example_en: I was gasping for a cold drink after running the race.
example_uz: Poygadan keyin chanqoqdan o'layozib, sovuq ichimlik ichgim keldi.

definition_en: A powerful wish or spell that is intended to cause harm to someone.
example_en: The old legend says the hidden treasure carries a terrible family curse.
example_uz: Eski rivoyatlarga ko'ra, bu yashirin xazina yomon bir qarg'ishga ega.

definition_en: The sound or act of firing a bullet from a gun.
example_en: We all jumped in fear when we heard a sudden loud gunshot.
example_uz: To'satdan quloqqa chalingan o'q ovozini eshitib, hammamiz seskanib ketdik.

definition_en: To hold someone tightly in your arms to show love or affection.
example_en: She ran to the door to give her father a big hug.
example_uz: U otasini quchoqlash uchun eshik tomon yugurib ketdi.

definition_en: A person who is not successful in life or at a specific task.
example_en: He never gives up easily, even though he feels like a loser.
example_uz: O'zini omadsiz deb hisoblasa ham, u hech qachon taslim bo'lmaydi.

definition_en: Crying noisily while taking short, sudden breaths.
example_en: The sobbing child finally calmed down after her mother arrived home.
example_uz: Onasi uyga kelgach, yig'layotgan bola nihoyat tinchlandi.

definition_en: A word used to show approval or praise for a great performance.
example_en: Bravo, you have done a brilliant job on this difficult project!
example_uz: Ofarin, sen bu qiyin ishni juda yaxshi uddalading!

definition_en: To force a person to have sex against their will.
example_en: The law takes strict measures against those who commit such crimes.
example_uz: Qonun bunday jinoyatlarni sodir etganlarga nisbatan qat'iy choralar ko'radi.

definition_en: Making a low, rough sound in the throat, usually indicating anger or hunger.
example_en: The growling dog stood in front of the house, blocking our path.
example_uz: G'iringlayotgan it uy oldida turib, yo'limizni to'sib qo'ydi.

definition_en: To breathe air out from your lungs.
example_en: He slowly exhales as he finishes his yoga exercise to relax.
example_uz: U tinchlanish uchun yoga mashqini tugatib, sekin nafas chiqaradi.

definition_en: Loved very much by someone.
example_en: She returned to her beloved hometown after living abroad for many years.
example_uz: U ko'p yillar chet elda yashaganidan so'ng o'zining sevimli shahriga qaytdi.

definition_en: A word used by young children to refer to their mother.
example_en: I told my mummy that I wanted a new toy today.
example_uz: Bugun o‘yinchoq xohlayotganimni oyijonimga aytdim.

definition_en: An informal way to refer to a group of men or friends.
example_en: The fellas are going to play football in the park tonight.
example_uz: Yigitlar bugun kechqurun parkda futbol o‘ynamoqchi.

definition_en: Speaking very quietly using your breath rather than your throat.
example_en: She was whispering secrets to her best friend in the corner.
example_uz: U burchakda dugonasiga sirli gaplarni pichirlab aytayotgan edi.

definition_en: The loud, harsh sound made by a dog.
example_en: The loud barking of the dog woke me up quite early.
example_uz: Itning qattiq hurishi meni erta uyg‘otib yubordi.

definition_en: A person employed to perform cleaning and household chores in a home.
example_en: The maid comes to clean our hotel room every morning.
example_uz: Farrosh har kuni ertalab mehmonxona xonamizni tozalashga keladi.

definition_en: Causing a feeling of uncomfortable shame or making you feel silly in public.
example_en: It was very embarrassing when I forgot my friend's name in class.
example_uz: Darsda do'stimning ismini esdan chiqarib qo'yganim juda noqulay holat bo'ldi.

definition_en: An evil spirit or creature from mythology or religion that is thought to be dangerous.
example_en: In the old story the hero fights a powerful demon in the cave.
example_uz: Qadimgi ertakda qahramon g'orda kuchli jin bilan jang qiladi.

definition_en: When two or more events happen at the same time by chance, not on purpose.
example_en: It is a strange coincidence that we are staying at the same hotel.
example_uz: Bizning bir xil mehmonxonada turishimiz g'alati tasodif.

definition_en: Extremely good or impressive.
example_en: She did a terrific job on her final project for the school.
example_uz: U maktabdagi yakuniy loyihasi uchun juda ajoyib ish qildi.

definition_en: Doing something without making much noise.
example_en: The cat walked quietly across the floor so it would not wake me.
example_uz: Mushuk meni uyg'otmaslik uchun pol bo'ylab tinchgina yurib o'tdi.

definition_en: A small object that makes a high-pitched sound when you blow air through it.
example_en: The referee blew his whistle to stop the football match.
example_uz: Hakam futbol o'yinini to'xtatish uchun hushtagini chaldi.

definition_en: Words shown at the bottom of a screen to translate what characters are saying.
example_en: I always watch foreign movies with English subtitles to improve my language.
example_uz: Til o‘rganish uchun xorijiy filmlarni doim inglizcha subtitrlar bilan tomosha qilaman.

definition_en: Willing to cause pain or suffering to other people or animals.
example_en: It is cruel to keep a bird in a very small cage.
example_uz: Qushni juda kichkina katakda saqlash shafqatsizlikdir.

definition_en: To put a dead body into the ground.
example_en: The dog ran into the garden to bury his favorite old bone.
example_uz: It o‘zining sevimli suyaklarini ko‘mish uchun bog‘ga yugurib ketdi.

definition_en: Something so weak or bad that it makes people feel pity or contempt.
example_en: His performance was pathetic; he did not even try to finish it.
example_uz: Uning ishi juda achinarli edi; u buni tugatishga harakat ham qilmadi.

definition_en: The quality of being brave and determined in a difficult or scary situation.
example_en: It must have taken some real guts to speak in front of everyone.
example_uz: Hamma oldida gapirish uchun haqiqiy jasorat kerak bo'lgan bo'lsa kerak.

definition_en: An informal way to refer to a man or a boy.
example_en: He is a nice fella who always helps his neighbors when needed.
example_uz: U qo'shnilariga har doim yordam beradigan yaxshi yigit.

definition_en: A long piece of furniture for several people to sit on comfortably.
example_en: We sat on the couch and watched a movie for two hours.
example_uz: Biz divanda o'tirib ikki soat davomida kino ko'rdik.

definition_en: A loud shout of joy, approval, or support for someone or something.
example_en: A loud cheer rose from the crowd when their team scored again.
example_uz: Jamoasi yana gol urganida olomondan baland hayqiriq eshitildi.

definition_en: Feeling nervous or uncomfortable when meeting or talking to other people.
example_en: She was very shy as a child but became more confident later.
example_uz: U bolaligida juda uyatchan edi, lekin keyinchalik o'ziga ishongan bo'lib qoldi.

definition_en: A small room or cupboard used for storing clothes or household supplies.
example_en: I hung my coat in the closet near the front door.
example_uz: Men paltomni kirish eshigi yonidagi kiyim javoniga osib qo'ydim.

definition_en: A person who is not brave and avoids doing things that are dangerous or difficult.
example_en: Only a coward would run away instead of facing the problem directly.
example_uz: Muammoni yuzma-yuz hal qilish o'rniga qochib ketadigan odam faqat qo'rqoqdir.

definition_en: A piece of equipment that makes a loud, high-pitched warning sound.
example_en: We heard the loud siren of an ambulance rushing to the hospital.
example_uz: Biz shifoxonaga shoshilayotgan tez yordam mashinasining baland sirena ovozini eshitdik.

definition_en: To say that you have done something wrong or illegal.
example_en: He had to confess to breaking the window during the ball game.
example_uz: U to'p o'yini paytida derazani sindirganini tan olishiga to'g'ri keldi.

definition_en: Feeling that someone is behaving in a dishonest or wrong way.
example_en: The police were suspicious of his story about where he was.
example_uz: Politsiya uning qayerda bo'lgani haqidagi hikoyasiga shubha bilan qaradi.

definition_en: Feeling fear or worry about something dangerous.
example_en: The little child was very frightened by the loud thunder last night.
example_uz: Kecha tunda kichkina bola kuchli momaqaldiroqdan juda qo'rqib ketdi.

definition_en: Very unhappy and uncomfortable.
example_en: I felt miserable because I was sick and stayed home all day.
example_uz: Kasal bo'lib butun kun uyda qolganim uchun o'zimni baxtsiz his qildim.

definition_en: Very much or to a great degree.
example_en: I am terribly sorry for being so late to our important meeting.
example_uz: Muhim yig'ilishimizga bunchalik kechikkanim uchun judayam uzr so'rayman.

definition_en: To take someone away by force, usually to ask for money.
example_en: The famous business leader was kidnapped on his way to work.
example_uz: Mashhur biznes rahbari ishga ketayotganda o'g'irlab ketildi.

definition_en: To speak or call out in a very loud voice.
example_en: Please do not shout at me because I can hear you.
example_uz: Iltimos, menga baqirma, chunki seni eshitib turibman.

definition_en: An act of kindness that you do for someone to help them.
example_en: Could you do me a small favour and open the window?
example_uz: Menga kichik bir yaxshilik qilib derazani ochib yuborolasizmi?

definition_en: A small part of a plant that develops into a flower or leaf.
example_en: The cherry tree is covered in pink buds ready to open.
example_uz: Olcha daraxti ochilishga tayyor pushti g'unchalar bilan qoplangan.

definition_en: On or inside a ship, plane, or other vehicle.
example_en: Welcome aboard the flight from London to Tashkent this morning.
example_uz: Bugun ertalab Londondan Toshkentga uchadigan reysimizga xush kelibsiz.

definition_en: The salty liquid that comes through your skin when you are hot.
example_en: He wiped the sweat from his forehead after the long run.
example_uz: U uzoq yugurishdan keyin peshonasidagi terni artib tashladi.

definition_en: To break something by hitting it or using too much force.
example_en: I busted my laptop screen while I was cleaning my desk yesterday.
example_uz: Kecha stolimni tozalayotganda noutbukimning ekranini sindirib qo‘ydim.

definition_en: To stop fighting or resisting and admit that you have been defeated.
example_en: The soldiers had no choice but to surrender to the enemy troops.
example_uz: Askarlarning dushmanga taslim bo‘lishdan boshqa chorasi qolmagandi.

definition_en: To press something so hard that it is damaged or loses its shape.
example_en: You need to crush the garlic cloves before adding them to food.
example_uz: Sarimsoqni taomga qo‘shishdan oldin uni ezib maydalashingiz kerak.

definition_en: A friend, especially someone you work or fight with in a group.
example_en: The soldiers shared their food and supplies with every fellow comrade.
example_uz: Askarlar oziq-ovqat va anjomlarini barcha safdoshlari bilan bo‘lishishdi.

definition_en: To demand that something happen or be done and refuse to change your mind.
example_en: He insisted that we stay for dinner despite our busy schedule today.
example_uz: Ishlarimiz ko'pligiga qaramay u bizni kechki ovqatga qolishimizga turib oldi.

definition_en: Thinking only about yourself and not caring about the needs of other people.
example_en: It is selfish of him to take the last piece of cake.
example_uz: Tortning oxirgi bo'lagini olishi uning xudbinligidan dalolat.

definition_en: The bone structure that forms the head and protects the brain.
example_en: He suffered a fracture to his skull after the bad fall.
example_uz: Qattiq yiqilganidan keyin uning kalla suyagi yorildi.

definition_en: To break a promise or be disloyal to someone who trusted you.
example_en: She felt betrayed when her best friend told everyone her secret.
example_uz: Eng yaqin do'sti sirini hammaga aytib qo'yganida u o'zini xiyonat qilingandek his qildi.

definition_en: A person hired to perform household duties or help another person with their work.
example_en: The household employed a servant to keep the large property clean daily.
example_uz: Katta xonadonni toza saqlash uchun ular xizmatkor yollashgan.

definition_en: Almost completely or in a way that is true even if not officially stated.
example_en: The project is practically finished and ready for the final inspection now.
example_uz: Loyiha deyarli tugagan va hozir yakuniy tekshiruvga tayyor.

definition_en: To clean or dry something by moving a cloth or your hand across it.
example_en: Please wipe the kitchen table after you finish eating your lunch today.
example_uz: Tushlik qilib bo'lganingdan keyin oshxona stolini artib qo'y.

definition_en: Having been defeated in a contest or having lost a fight or game.
example_en: The beaten team walked off the field with their heads held low.
example_uz: Yengilgan jamoa boshlarini quyi solib maydonni tark etdi.

definition_en: A mild expression used to show annoyance or surprise instead of saying a swear word.
example_en: Heck, I forgot to bring my keys when I left the house.
example_uz: Jin ursin, uydan chiqayotib kalitlarimni olishni unutibman.

definition_en: To suddenly understand or become aware of a fact or situation.
example_en: I did not realise how important this meeting was for the company.
example_uz: Bu uchrashuv kompaniya uchun qanchalik muhimligini tushunib yetmagan ekanman.

definition_en: The sound made by someone walking on the ground.
example_en: I heard heavy footsteps coming towards my room in the middle night.
example_uz: Tunda xonam tomonga yaqinlashayotgan og‘ir qadam tovushlarini eshitdim.

definition_en: A polite phrase used when saying goodbye in the evening or before going to sleep.
example_en: It is getting very late now, so I will say goodnight to you.
example_uz: Vaqt juda kech bo‘lib qoldi, shuning uchun sizga xayrli tun tilayman.

definition_en: A friendly way to refer to a boy or a young man.
example_en: Come here, lad, and help me move these heavy boxes to the truck.
example_uz: Beri kel, yigit, yuk mashinasiga mana bu og‘ir qutilarni ko‘tarishga yordamlashib yubor.

definition_en: Past simple tense of wear, meaning to have clothes on your body.
example_en: He wore a blue suit during his important meeting with the director.
example_uz: U direktor bilan muhim uchrashuvda ko‘k rangli kostyum kiygandi.

definition_en: To ask someone for something in a very desperate or sincere way.
example_en: She is begging him to stay for one more day of the holiday.
example_uz: U yigitdan ta’tilning yana bir kuniga qolishini o‘tinib so‘ramoqda.

definition_en: A statement where someone admits that they have done something wrong or illegal.
example_en: Without the real murderer's confession, an innocent person could be jailed.
example_uz: Haqiqiy qotil aybiga iqror bo'lmaguncha aybsiz odam qamalib qolishi mumkin edi.

definition_en: Used when saying what you really think about a situation in an honest way.
example_en: Most of what they said was, frankly, a pack of lies.
example_uz: Ularning aytganlari, rostini aytsam, shunchaki yolg'on gaplar edi.

definition_en: Directly below or covered by something else.
example_en: I found the old key hidden underneath the rug in the hall.
example_uz: Eski kalitni kor ostidan topib oldim.

definition_en: To believe, think, or have an opinion about something.
example_en: I reckon we should start the meeting without waiting for him.
example_uz: Menimcha, uni kutmasdan yig'ilishni boshlayverishimiz kerak.

definition_en: To a very great degree or intensity.
example_en: It was an incredibly busy day at the office yesterday.
example_uz: Kecha idorada nihoyatda gavjum kun bo'ldi.

definition_en: A feeling of coldness that causes your body to shake slightly.
example_en: Close the window because I can feel a chill in the room.
example_uz: Derazani yopib qo'y, xonada sovuq sezilyapti.

definition_en: To force liquid out from your mouth.
example_en: It is considered very rude to spit on the street.
example_uz: Ko'chada tupurish juda odobsizlik hisoblanadi.

definition_en: A button outside a house that makes a sound when pressed.
example_en: Someone is pressing the doorbell, could you go and check?
example_uz: Kimdir eshik qo'ng'irog'ini chalyapti, borib qarangchi?

definition_en: Things that make you feel anxious or unhappy about your life or future.
example_en: You need to leave all your daily worries behind while on vacation.
example_uz: Ta'tilda bo'lganingizda kundalik barcha tashvishlarni unutishingiz kerak.

definition_en: The son of your brother or your sister.
example_en: My nephew is coming to visit us for the summer holidays.
example_uz: Jiyanim yozgi ta'tilda biznikiga mehmonga kelyapti.

definition_en: A person who betrays someone or their country.
example_en: He was considered a traitor for sharing military secrets with the enemy.
example_uz: U harbiy sirlarni dushmanga oshkor qilgani uchun xoin deb hisoblandi.

definition_en: A set of clothes that you wear together.
example_en: She wore a very elegant outfit to her sister's wedding party.
example_uz: U opasining to'yida juda chiroyli kiyim kiyib chiqdi.

definition_en: Money paid to a court to allow a prisoner to be released until trial.
example_en: The judge granted bail to the suspect after hearing the evidence.
example_uz: Sudya dalillarni eshitgach, gumonlanuvchini garov evaziga ozod qildi.

definition_en: The ability to stay calm and not get annoyed while waiting for something.
example_en: Learning a new language requires a great deal of patience and effort.
example_uz: Yangi tilni o'rganish juda katta sabr va mehnat talab qiladi.

definition_en: Showing a lack of good judgment; unwise or silly.
example_en: It was foolish of him to leave his keys in the car.
example_uz: Mashinada kalitni qoldirib ketishi ahmoqona ish bo'ldi.

definition_en: Causing embarrassment or making you feel uncomfortable and self-conscious.
example_en: An awkward silence had fallen when we started talking about money.
example_uz: Pul haqida gapira boshlaganimizda noqulay sukunat cho'kdi.

definition_en: Extremely or very dirty.
example_en: The floor was absolutely filthy after the children played in the mud.
example_uz: Bolalar loyda o'ynaganidan keyin pol juda iflos bo'lib ketdi.

definition_en: At or to an unspecified location.
example_en: I must have left my keys someplace in the living room.
example_uz: Kalitlarimni mehmonxonaning biror joyida qoldirgan bo'lsam kerak.

definition_en: To stop someone while they are talking or doing something.
example_en: Please do not interrupt me while I am finishing my report.
example_uz: Hisobotimni tugatib olayotganimda iltimos gapimni bo'lmang.

definition_en: To make a short, loud sound, especially using a car horn.
example_en: The driver started to beep his horn because of the traffic.
example_uz: Tirbandlik sababli haydovchi signal bera boshladi.

definition_en: Feeling extremely hungry because you have not eaten for a long time.
example_en: I haven't eaten all day, I am absolutely starving right now.
example_uz: Kun bo'yi hech narsa yemadim, hozir juda ochman.

definition_en: To go to a place and bring back something or someone.
example_en: Could you please fetch me a glass of water from the kitchen?
example_uz: Iltimos, oshxonadan bir stakan suv olib kela olasizmi?

definition_en: An unhappy feeling caused by knowing that you have done something wrong.
example_en: He felt a deep sense of guilt for hurting his friend's feelings.
example_uz: U do'stining ko'nglini og'ritib qo'ygani uchun chuqur vijdon azobini his qildi.

definition_en: The part of your mind that tells you what is morally right or wrong.
example_en: It is important to always act according to your own clear conscience.
example_uz: Har doim o'z vijdoningiz oldida toza bo'lib ish tutish muhimdir.

definition_en: Feeling very tired and having difficulty breathing after physical exercise.
example_en: After running for a mile, he was completely blown and needed rest.
example_uz: Bir mil yugurganidan keyin u butunlay hansirab qoldi va dam olishi kerak edi.

definition_en: To wave your hand to attract the attention of a taxi or person.
example_en: It was raining hard, so I tried to hail a passing taxi.
example_uz: Qattiq yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi, shuning uchun o'tib ketayotgan taksini to'xtatishga urindim.

definition_en: Not feeling happy; feeling sad or not satisfied with a situation.
example_en: The child was unhappy because he could not find his favorite toy.
example_uz: Bola sevimli o'yinchog'ini topa olmagani uchun xafa edi.

definition_en: A word you say when you feel sudden pain.
example_en: Ouch! You stepped on my toe! That hurt!
example_uz: Voy! Oyogimni bosib olding! Og'rib ketdi!

definition_en: Words said to show that you are sorry for doing something wrong.
example_en: The CEO made a public apology for the scandal to the staff.
example_uz: Bosh direktor janjal uchun xodimlardan omma oldida uzr so'radi.

definition_en: The person or thing that you like more than any other.
example_en: This is my favourite song, I listen to it every day.
example_uz: Bu mening sevimli qo'shig'im, uni har kuni eshitaman.

definition_en: Always supporting a person, organization, or country.
example_en: Dogs are very loyal animals, which is why they make wonderful pets.
example_uz: Itlar juda sodiq jonivor, shuning uchun ular eng yaxshi uy hayvonidir.

definition_en: Waste material produced by an animal or bird.
example_en: We found some rabbit dropping near the vegetable patch in the garden.
example_uz: Bog'dagi sabzavotlar yonida quyonning ahlatini topib oldik.

definition_en: Decayed and no longer good to eat or use because of bacteria.
example_en: If you leave fruit out for weeks, it will eventually go rotten.
example_uz: Agar mevalarni bir necha hafta ochiq qoldirsangiz, ular oxiri chirib ketadi.

definition_en: The period of time between two events happening.
example_en: The doctor will see you shortly; in the meantime, please wait here.
example_uz: Shifokor yaqin daqiqalarda sizni qabul qiladi, shu vaqtda shu yerda kutib turing.

definition_en: A man who lives a religious life away from society in a monastery.
example_en: The monk spent his entire day praying in the quiet mountain temple.
example_uz: Rohib butun kunini tog'dagi sokin ibodatxonada duo qilib o'tkazdi.

definition_en: Very bad, poor quality, or feeling physically unwell.
example_en: I caught a bad cold and have been feeling lousy all week.
example_uz: Meni shamollash tutdi va butun hafta o'zimni juda yomon his qilyapman.

definition_en: Having an incorrect belief or idea about something.
example_en: I think you are mistaken about the time of our meeting.
example_uz: O'ylashimcha, siz uchrashuvimiz vaqti borasida adashgansiz.

definition_en: Not feeling relaxed or feeling physical pain or worry.
example_en: The hard wooden chair made me feel very uncomfortable during class.
example_uz: Qattiq yog'och stul dars davomida o'zimni juda noqulay his qilishimga sabab bo'ldi.

definition_en: A man who is a member of the police force.
example_en: The policeman helped the child find his parents in the park.
example_uz: Militsiya xodimi bolaga bog'da ota-onasini topishga yordam berdi.

definition_en: The property that objects have which you see with your eyes.
example_en: What is your favourite colour to wear in the summer?
example_uz: Yozda kiyish uchun eng sevimli rangingiz qaysi?

definition_en: To produce tears because you are sad or hurt.
example_en: The little boy cried when he dropped his ice cream cone.
example_uz: Bolakay muzqaymog'ini tushirib yuborgach yig'lab yubordi.

definition_en: To steal money or property from a person or place by force.
example_en: The criminals robbed the bank during the busy morning hours.
example_uz: Jinoyatchilar bandlik vaqtida bankni talab ketishdi.

definition_en: A friendly or affectionate word for your aunt.
example_en: My dear auntie brought me a present from her trip.
example_uz: Mehribon xolajonim safardan menga sovg'a olib keldi.

definition_en: Small insects with two wings that often live near food.
example_en: Please cover the food so the flies cannot land on it.
example_uz: Ovqatni yopib qo'ying, pashshalar qo'nmasin.

definition_en: To make a long and very loud sound of sadness or pain.
example_en: The child was wailing loudly because he had lost his mother.
example_uz: Bola onasini yo'qotib qo'ygani uchun dod solib yig'layotgan edi.

definition_en: To shout loudly, often because you are angry or excited.
example_en: It is rude to yell at your friends when you are angry.
example_uz: Jahl chiqqanda do'stlaringizga baqirish odobsizlikdir.

definition_en: The illegal act of killing another person.
example_en: The detective is investigating a recent homicide in the city center.
example_uz: Detektiv shahar markazida sodir bo'lgan qotillikni tekshirmoqda.

definition_en: The past tense form of fly, moving through the air with wings.
example_en: The bird quickly flew away when it saw the hungry cat.
example_uz: Qush och mushukni ko‘rishi bilan tezda uchib ketdi.

definition_en: To hit someone or something quickly with the palm of your open hand.
example_en: She tried to slap the mosquito away from her tired face.
example_uz: U charchagan yuzidagi chivinni shapatilab tushirmoqchi bo‘ldi.

definition_en: Making a very loud and sharp high-pitched sound, often due to pain or fear.
example_en: The tires were screeching as the car turned the corner very fast.
example_uz: Mashina keskin burilishda g‘ildiraklari g‘iyqillab ketdi.

definition_en: Making a long, low sound of pain, suffering, or deep sadness.
example_en: The injured man was moaning quietly while waiting for the doctor to arrive.
example_uz: Yarador odam shifokor kelishini kutib, past ovozda ingrayotgan edi.

definition_en: A formal or polite expression of good wishes when someone is leaving.
example_en: The entire team gathered to bid a final farewell to their leader.
example_uz: Butun jamoa o‘z rahbarlari bilan xayrlashish uchun to‘planishdi.

definition_en: The past tense form of slip, meaning to slide accidentally on a smooth surface.
example_en: He slipped on the icy sidewalk and fell down during his morning walk.
example_uz: U ertalabki sayr paytida muzlagan yo‘lakda sirpanib ketib yiqildi.

definition_en: A performer who wears bright clothes and makeup to make people laugh, often at a circus.
example_en: The clown at the birthday party made all the children laugh loudly.
example_uz: Tug'ilgan kun bazmidagi masxaraboz barcha bolalarni kuldirib yubordi.

definition_en: Based on strict rules or facts, even if it is not how things usually appear.
example_en: Technically, the project is finished, but we still have a few details.
example_uz: Aslida loyiha tugatilgan, lekin hali kichik kamchiliklarimiz bor.

definition_en: A word used to show surprise, frustration, or annoyance at something happening.
example_en: Jeez, you really scared me when you jumped out from behind that door!
example_uz: Voy, eshik ortidan chiqib kelib meni juda qo'rqitib yubording!

definition_en: Determined not to change your opinion or attitude, even when you should.
example_en: He is so stubborn that he never listens to anyone else's good advice.
example_uz: U shunchalik o'jar-ki, hech kimning yaxshi maslahatiga quloq solmaydi.

definition_en: Having a long cut or a hole in material like cloth or paper.
example_en: He wore a pair of old ripped jeans to the casual party.
example_uz: U oddiy bazmga yirtiq jinsida bordi.

definition_en: Making a low, continuous, and soft sound while moving or spinning fast.
example_en: I could hear the whirring sound of the computer fan inside.
example_uz: Men kompyuter ventilyatorining guldira-guldira aylanishini eshitib turardim.

definition_en: Took hold of something suddenly or with force.
example_en: She grabbed her bag and ran out of the house quickly.
example_uz: U sumkasini tutib oldi-da, uydan shoshib chiqib ketdi.

definition_en: To cut something into smaller pieces using a knife or an axe.
example_en: Please chop the onions into small pieces for the soup tonight.
example_uz: Iltimos, bugungi sho'rva uchun piyozni maydalab to'g'rab qo'y.

definition_en: A title used for a member of the Christian clergy or church minister.
example_en: The reverend gave a moving speech about kindness during the service.
example_uz: Ruhoniy marosim paytida ezgulik haqida ta'sirli nutq so'zladi.

definition_en: To go with someone to make sure they arrive safely or to leave a place.
example_en: Security guards had to escort the aggressive visitor out of the building.
example_uz: Qo'riqchilar tajovuzkor tashrif buyuruvchini binodan tashqariga kuzatib qo'yishga majbur bo'lishdi.

definition_en: The physical body of a person or animal that is dead.
example_en: The police discovered a cold corpse lying on the forest floor today.
example_uz: Politsiya bugun o'rmon tubida yotgan sovuq jasadni topib oldi.

definition_en: In a way that is quiet or gentle, not loud or harsh.
example_en: The mother sang softly to her baby to help him fall asleep.
example_uz: Ona bolasi uxlab qolishi uchun unga past ovozda qo'shiq aytdi.

definition_en: Causing a feeling of fear or disgust because of something strange or unnatural.
example_en: There was a creepy man standing in the dark corner of the room.
example_uz: Xonaning qorong'u burchagida vahimali bir odam turgan edi.

definition_en: To move quietly and secretly to avoid being seen or heard by others.
example_en: I tried to sneak out of the house without waking my parents up.
example_uz: Ota-onamni uyg'otmasdan uyga bildirmay kirishga harakat qildim.

definition_en: To give a formal statement about what you know in a court of law.
example_en: The witness had to testify in court about what he saw yesterday.
example_uz: Guvoh kecha nimalarni ko'rgani haqida sudda ko'rsatma berishi kerak edi.

definition_en: The quality of being faithful to a person, group, or set of beliefs.
example_en: He showed great loyalty to his football club despite their many defeats.
example_uz: U ko'p mag'lubiyatlarga qaramay o'z futbol klubiga katta sadoqat ko'rsatdi.

definition_en: To produce tears from your eyes because you are sad or hurt.
example_en: The little child cries whenever his mother leaves the room for work.
example_uz: Kichkina bola onasi ishga ketganda har doim yig'laydi.

definition_en: A person who dances, often as a job or for professional entertainment.
example_en: The professional dancer performed a beautiful routine on the large stage.
example_uz: Professional raqqosa katta sahnada juda chiroyli raqs ijro etdi.

definition_en: A very stupid person who behaves in a silly or foolish way.
example_en: Only a complete moron would leave the keys inside the locked car.
example_uz: Faqat ahmoq odamgina kalitni qulflangan mashina ichida qoldirib ketadi.

definition_en: A type of drinking mug shaped like a person wearing a hat.
example_en: Grandfather kept his collection of vintage toby mugs on the shelf.
example_uz: Bobom o'zining qadimiy ko'za kolleksiyasini javonda saqlardi.

definition_en: To pull something heavy across the ground with difficulty.
example_en: He dragged the heavy bag across the floor to the closet.
example_uz: U og'ir sumkani polda sudrab, shkafga olib bordi.

definition_en: Things that are unwanted and thrown away by people.
example_en: Please take the rubbish out to the bin before you go.
example_uz: Iltimos, chiqib ketishdan oldin axlatni idishga tashlab yubor.

definition_en: The part of the body that you sit on.
example_en: My bum hurts because I have been sitting for six hours.
example_uz: Olti soat o'tirganim uchun dumg'azam og'riyapti.

definition_en: A narrow road or path between buildings.
example_en: The cat ran quickly down the dark alley behind the restaurant.
example_uz: Mushuk restoran ortidagi qorong'u tor ko'cha bo'ylab yugurib ketdi.

definition_en: A meal eaten in the evening.
example_en: We usually have supper together as a family every night.
example_uz: Biz odatda har oqshom oilaviy kechki ovqat qilamiz.

definition_en: Evidence proving that a person was elsewhere when a crime was committed.
example_en: The suspect provided a strong alibi for the night of the crime.
example_uz: Gumonlanuvchi jinoyat sodir etilgan kecha uchun kuchli alibi ko'rsatdi.

definition_en: A hard grey fuel made by heating coal, used in iron production.
example_en: Industrial steel production often requires the use of high-quality coke.
example_uz: Sanoatda po'lat ishlab chiqarish ko'pincha sifatli koks ishlatishni talab qiladi.

definition_en: The liquid in which meat or vegetables have been boiled.
example_en: She added the meat liquor to the pot to enhance the flavor.
example_uz: Ta'mini yaxshilash uchun u qozonga go'sht qaynatilgan suvni qo'shdi.

definition_en: A woman whose husband has died and who has not remarried.
example_en: The widow lived alone in the cottage after her husband passed away.
example_uz: Eri vafot etgach, beva ayol uyda yolg'iz yashadi.

definition_en: Deep sadness that you feel when someone you love dies or leaves.
example_en: He was overwhelmed with grief after hearing the sad news.
example_uz: Mash'um xabarni eshitgach, u qattiq qayg'uga botdi.

definition_en: A pain or uncomfortable feeling in your head.
example_en: I have a splitting headache after that party last night.
example_uz: Kechagi bazmdan keyin boshim yorilgudek og'riyapti.

definition_en: Making a low, continuous sound with your mouth closed.
example_en: The bees were humming softly in the garden this morning.
example_uz: Bugun ertalab bog'da asalarilar mayin g'o'ng'illardi.

definition_en: People who steal things from other people.
example_en: The police caught the thieves trying to break into the bank.
example_uz: Politsiya bankka kirmoqchi bo'lgan o'g'rilarni ushladi.

definition_en: A reason or expression of disagreement against something.
example_en: Does anyone have an objection to starting the meeting now?
example_uz: Yig'ilishni hozir boshlashimizga kimningdir e'tirozi bormi?

definition_en: A strong alcoholic drink made from grain such as barley.
example_en: He poured a glass of whiskey and sat by the fire.
example_uz: U bir stakan viski quyib, olov yoniga o'tirdi.

definition_en: To have pushed a pointed weapon like a knife into someone or something.
example_en: The victim was stabbed during the fight and taken to the hospital.
example_uz: Janjal paytida jabrlanuvchi pichoqlanib, kasalxonaga yotqizildi.

definition_en: A cupboard that can be locked to keep your personal items safe at school or gym.
example_en: I left my heavy books inside my school locker after the final class.
example_uz: Darslar tugagach, og‘ir kitoblarimni maktabdagi shkafchamga qoldirdim.

definition_en: To make a tiny hole in something using a sharp point.
example_en: The nurse asked me to relax so she could prick my finger for blood.
example_uz: Hamshira qon tahlili uchun barmog‘imni sanchishidan oldin bo‘shashishimni so‘radi.

definition_en: In a pleasant, kind, or very satisfactory way.
example_en: The living room was decorated very nicely with bright flowers and new curtains.
example_uz: Mehmonxona yorqin gullar va yangi pardalar bilan juda chiroyli bezatilgan edi.

definition_en: A high-ranking officer in charge of a country's navy.
example_en: The admiral ordered the fleet to return to the base due to the storm.
example_uz: Admiral bo‘ron tufayli flotga bazaga qaytishni buyurdi.

definition_en: The past tense of sing, meaning to make musical sounds with your voice.
example_en: She sang a beautiful song during the school concert last night.
example_uz: U kecha maktab konsertida juda chiroyli qo'shiq aytdi.

definition_en: An informal way of saying give me.
example_en: Gimme the ball so I can start the game with everyone.
example_uz: To'pni ber, o'yinni boshlaylik.

definition_en: Something that has been damaged or made black by too much heat or fire.
example_en: The toast was too burnt to eat for my breakfast this morning.
example_uz: Non juda qattiq kuyib ketgani uchun nonushtaga yeb bo'lmasdi.

definition_en: A person held by someone to force others to do what they want.
example_en: The criminals held the bank employees as hostages for several long hours.
example_uz: Jinoyatchilar bank xodimlarini bir necha soat davomida garovda ushlab turishdi.

definition_en: To say or do something that is rude and offends another person.
example_en: It is never acceptable to insult someone just because they disagree publicly.
example_uz: Kimnidir shunchaki fikriga qo'shilmaganing uchun haqorat qilish mutlaqo noto'g'ri.

definition_en: To become healthy again after an injury or illness.
example_en: The cut on his hand will take a few days to heal.
example_uz: Qo'lidagi kesilgan joyi bir necha kunda bitib ketadi.

definition_en: A holiday taken by a couple who have just got married.
example_en: They went to the Maldives for their honeymoon last summer.
example_uz: Ular o'tgan yili asal oyini o'tkazish uchun Maldiv orollariga borishdi.

definition_en: A tall machine used for moving heavy objects on construction sites.
example_en: The crane lifted the heavy metal beams to the top floor.
example_uz: Kran og'ir metall to'sinlarni yuqori qavatga ko'tarib qo'ydi.

definition_en: To make a low, angry sound in the throat, usually by an animal.
example_en: The angry dog growls whenever anyone approaches the front gate.
example_uz: Darvozaga kimdir yaqinlashsa, jahldor it vovullaydi.

definition_en: In a cheerful and willing way.
example_en: I will happily help you finish the project this evening.
example_uz: Loyihani yakunlashga bu oqshom bajonidil yordam beraman.

definition_en: A short period of time during which someone suffers from an illness.
example_en: He missed several days of work due to a bout of flu.
example_uz: U gripp xuruji tufayli bir necha kun ishga chiqa olmadi.

definition_en: Feeling nervous and unable to relax because of worry or stress.
example_en: The atmosphere in the meeting room was very tense and quiet.
example_uz: Majlis xonasidagi muhit juda tarang va sokin edi.

definition_en: A large amount of things gathered together in one place.
example_en: She left a large pile of books on the kitchen table.
example_uz: U oshxona stolining ustiga katta kitoblar toʻdasini tashlab ketdi.

definition_en: A white powder used in cooking to help dough rise or for cleaning.
example_en: I always use baking soda when I make my favorite cake.
example_uz: Men sevimli tortimni pishirganimda har doim isteʼmol sodasidan foydalanaman.

definition_en: Used to emphasize a quality, meaning very or extremely.
example_en: The weather was awfully cold when we arrived in the city.
example_uz: Shaharga yetib borganimizda havo nihoyatda sovuq edi.

definition_en: To move by lifting your foot and putting it down in a new place.
example_en: He stepped outside to get some fresh air in the morning.
example_uz: U ertalab toza havodan nafas olish uchun tashqariga chiqdi.

definition_en: A thick, high-quality slice of meat, usually beef, cooked by grilling or frying.
example_en: Would you prefer to eat a chicken or a beef steak?
example_uz: Tovuq goʻshti yoki mol goʻshti steykini yeyishni xohlaysizmi?

definition_en: The special chair used by a king or queen during important official events.
example_en: The young prince will finally sit on the throne next week.
example_uz: Yosh shahzoda kelasi hafta nihoyat taxtga o‘tiradi.

definition_en: Feeling very unhappy and without hope for a long period of time.
example_en: She felt very depressed after losing her job last month.
example_uz: O‘tgan oy ishdan bo‘shatilgach, u o‘zini juda tushkun his qildi.

definition_en: A female spirit or being that is believed to have magical powers.
example_en: Ancient stories describe a goddess who controlled the sea and storms.
example_uz: Qadimiy afsonalarda dengiz va bo‘ronlarni boshqaradigan iloha haqida hikoya qilinadi.

definition_en: The bottom part of your face below your mouth.
example_en: He has a small cut on his chin from shaving today.
example_uz: Bugun soqol olayotganda iyagiga biroz tig‘ tegib ketdi.

definition_en: Routine tasks that involve dealing with official documents and forms.
example_en: I hate spending all my time at the office doing boring paperwork.
example_uz: Ofisda zerikarli qogʻozbozlik bilan shugʻullanib vaqt oʻtkazishni yoqtirmayman.

definition_en: Thinking about someone or something all the time in a very strong way.
example_en: He has been completely obsessed with computer games for the last month.
example_uz: U oʻtgan oydan beri kompyuter oʻyinlariga butunlay mukkasidan ketgan.

definition_en: To press something firmly with your hands or fingers.
example_en: Please do not squeeze the toothpaste tube from the very middle.
example_uz: Iltimos tish pastasi tubigini qoq oʻrtasidan siqmang.

definition_en: A continuous low, deep sound, like thunder or a distant engine.
example_en: The low rumbling of distant thunder echoed through the dark valley.
example_uz: Uzoqdagi momaqaldiroqning guldurashi qorongʻu vodiy boʻylab aks sado berdi.

definition_en: Feeling love or affection for someone or liking something very much.
example_en: I am very fond of my grandmother because she tells great stories.
example_uz: Buvimni juda yaxshi koʻraman chunki u juda qiziqarli hikoyalar aytib beradi.

definition_en: At or to a point equally distant between the beginning and the end.
example_en: I was already halfway home when I realized I forgot my keys.
example_uz: Kalitlarimni unutganimni bilganimda uy yoʻlining yarmiga yetib qolgandim.

definition_en: To search through something quickly and messily to find or steal something.
example_en: He started to rifle through the drawers looking for his missing passport.
example_uz: U yoʻqolgan pasportini izlab tortmalarni titkilay boshladi.

definition_en: A figure of a person or animal made from stone, metal, or wood.
example_en: They built a tall bronze statue to honor the country's national hero.
example_uz: Ular mamlakat milliy qahramoni sharafiga baland bronza haykal oʻrnatdilar.

definition_en: To move your hand or an object back and forth against a surface with pressure.
example_en: I rubbed some cream onto my dry skin to make it soft.
example_uz: Quruq terim yumshoq bo'lishi uchun ozgina krem surtdim.

definition_en: A round open container with a handle used for carrying liquids or solids.
example_en: He filled the bucket with water to clean the dirty floor.
example_uz: U kir yerni tozalash uchun chelakka suv to'ldirdi.

definition_en: In a way that is not clear or easy to see or hear.
example_en: The old man spoke indistinctly and I could not understand him.
example_uz: Keksaygan odam juda noaniq gapirdi va men uni tushunmadim.

definition_en: A person whose job is to serve food and drinks to customers in restaurants.
example_en: I asked the waiter for the menu so we could order dinner.
example_uz: Kechki ovqatga buyurtma berish uchun ofitsiantdan menyuni so'radim.

definition_en: Having bad luck or resulting in a sad or unpleasant situation.
example_en: It was an unfortunate event that caused everyone to feel very sad.
example_uz: Bu hamma xafa bo'lishiga sabab bo'lgan afsuslanarli hodisa edi.

definition_en: A state of laughing in a nervous or silly way that is hard to stop.
example_en: We had a bad case of the giggles during the quiet meeting.
example_uz: Tinch majlis paytida birdan qiqirlab kulib yubordik.

definition_en: An opening that allows liquid or gas to escape where it should not.
example_en: We called a plumber to fix the leak in the kitchen sink.
example_uz: Oshxonadagi jo'mrakdan suv sizib chiqayotgani uchun santexnik chaqirdik.

definition_en: To let out a long, deep breath because of tiredness, sadness, or relief.
example_en: She was sighing with relief after finishing all her difficult exams.
example_uz: Barcha qiyin imtihonlarni topshirgach u yengil tortib xo'rsindi.

definition_en: Being unable to choose between two different actions or possibilities.
example_en: I am torn between taking the new job or staying in school.
example_uz: Men yangi ishga kirish yoki o'qishni davom ettirish o'rtasida ikkilanib turibman.

definition_en: To be dishonest to someone who trusts you or to reveal a secret.
example_en: He felt that his best friend had betrayed his deepest trust.
example_uz: U eng yaqin do'sti ishonchini suiiste'mol qilgan deb o'yladi.

definition_en: A lawyer who works for the government to prove someone is guilty in court.
example_en: The prosecutor asked the witness many questions about the night of the crime.
example_uz: Prokuror guvohga jinoyat sodir bo'lgan kecha haqida ko'p savollar berdi.

definition_en: A large bag made of strong paper or cloth used for carrying goods.
example_en: We bought a large sack of potatoes at the local market today.
example_uz: Bugun mahalliy bozordan bir qop kartoshka sotib oldik.

definition_en: To secretly give drugs to a person or animal to change their behavior.
example_en: The athlete was disqualified because someone tried to dope him before racing.
example_uz: Sportchi musobaqa oldidan dori berilgani uchun diskvalifikatsiya qilindi.

definition_en: A word for any type of alcohol or drink containing alcohol.
example_en: We bought some booze to celebrate the successful end of the project.
example_uz: Loyiha muvaffaqiyatli yakunlangani uchun biz bir oz spirtli ichimlik sotib oldik.

definition_en: A very strong, clear alcoholic drink made from grain or potatoes.
example_en: He ordered a glass of vodka with lemon at the bar.
example_uz: U barda bir stakan limonli aroq buyurtma qildi.

definition_en: Feeling extremely afraid of someone or something.
example_en: The young girl was terrified of the thunder during the storm.
example_uz: Qizaloq momaqaldiroq paytida qattiq qo'rqib ketdi.

definition_en: A large rectangular bag used for carrying clothes and belongings when traveling.
example_en: I need to pack my suitcase before leaving for the airport.
example_uz: Aeroportga jo'nashdan oldin chamadonimni yig'ishim kerak.

definition_en: Making short, high-pitched sounds, especially the sound made by birds or insects.
example_en: I woke up early to the sound of birds chirping outside.
example_uz: Tashqarida qushlarning sayrashidan erta uyg'onib ketdim.

definition_en: A formal dance party for high school or college students at the end of year.
example_en: Would you like to be my date for the senior prom?
example_uz: Bitiruv kechasiga men bilan birga borishni xohlaysanmi?

definition_en: Not good, unconvincing, or unlikely to be true.
example_en: He had a really lame excuse for missing the party.
example_uz: Kechaning qoldirilishi uchun u juda ishonarsiz bahona aytdi.

definition_en: To hit a person or animal with a long piece of leather or rope.
example_en: The rider had to whip the horse to make it run faster.
example_uz: Chavandoz otni tezroq yugurishi uchun qamchilashga majbur bo'ldi.

definition_en: The tendency to become angry very quickly.
example_en: He has a bad temper when he is under a lot of stress.
example_uz: U stress holatida bo'lganda juda jahldor bo'lib qoladi.

definition_en: Working secretly to discover information or catch criminals.
example_en: The undercover agent spent months working inside the criminal gang.
example_uz: Yashirin agent jinoyatchilar to'dasi ichida oylar davomida ishladi.

definition_en: To break something violently into many pieces.
example_en: The falling rock managed to smash the window into pieces.
example_uz: Tushayotgan tosh derazani chilparchin qilib sindirdi.

definition_en: Causing great sadness or involving a very bad and painful event.
example_en: The young athlete's early death was a truly tragic accident.
example_uz: Yosh sportchining erta vafot etishi juda fojiali voqea bo'ldi.

definition_en: Not affected by alcohol and therefore able to think clearly.
example_en: You must be completely sober if you are planning to drive home.
example_uz: Agar mashina haydab ketmoqchi bo'lsangiz, butunlay hushyor bo'lishingiz kerak.

definition_en: An informal way to refer to your sister.
example_en: I am going to the cinema with my little sis today.
example_uz: Bugun singlim bilan kinoga boryapman.

definition_en: The daughter of your brother or your sister.
example_en: My niece just celebrated her fifteenth birthday with a big party.
example_uz: Jiyanim yaqinda o'zining o'n besh yoshini katta ziyofat bilan nishonladi.

definition_en: Easily broken or damaged and needing to be treated with great care.
example_en: The negotiations were very delicate and required a calm approach from everyone.
example_uz: Muzokaralar juda nozik edi va barchadan xotirjam yondashuvni talab qildi.

definition_en: The son of your son or daughter.
example_en: The old man was very proud of his youngest grandson.
example_uz: Keksa odam eng kichik nabirasi bilan juda faxrlanardi.

definition_en: A negative quality or a lack of strength in a person or thing.
example_en: His inability to speak in front of an audience was his biggest weakness.
example_uz: Ommaviy chiqishlarda gapira olmaslik uning eng katta kamchiligi edi.

definition_en: A piece of soft cloth used for drying yourself or an object.
example_en: He needed a soft towel for drying his face after the shower.
example_uz: Dushdan keyin yuzini artish uchun unga yumshoq sochiq kerak bo'ldi.

definition_en: At the present time, in contrast with the past.
example_en: Cars nowadays are more efficient than those built twenty years ago.
example_uz: Hozirgi kunda mashinalar yigirma yil avvalgiga qaraganda tejamkorroq.

definition_en: A small telephone that you can carry with you everywhere.
example_en: I left my cellphone on the table in the kitchen earlier.
example_uz: Men mobil telefonimni oshxonadagi stol ustiga qoldirib ketibman.

definition_en: The sound or act of shooting one or more guns.
example_en: We heard heavy gunfire coming from the forest late last night.
example_uz: Kechasi o'rmon tomondan qattiq o'q ovozlari eshitildi.

definition_en: Towards the direction that is behind you.
example_en: He took a few steps backwards to avoid hitting the wall.
example_uz: Devorga urilib ketmaslik uchun u bir necha qadam ortga chekindi.

definition_en: A person who has a lot of power or influence in a particular industry.
example_en: The media baron decided which stories would appear in the newspaper.
example_uz: Ommaviy axborot vositalari magnati qaysi maqolalar gazetada chiqishini hal qildi.

definition_en: The illegal act of taking a person away by force.
example_en: The police are investigating the kidnapping of a famous local businessman.
example_uz: Politsiya mahalliy taniqli ishbilarmonning o'g'irlab ketilishini tekshirmoqda.

definition_en: To gather and organize facts or people in a clear and effective way.
example_en: She had to marshal all her arguments before the important debate.
example_uz: Muhim bahs-munozaradan oldin u barcha dalillarini tartibga solib olishi kerak edi.

definition_en: Not important and often concerned with small details that do not matter.
example_en: They spent hours arguing over petty issues instead of the main project.
example_uz: Ular asosiy loyiha o'rniga arzimas muammolar ustida soatlab bahslashishdi.

definition_en: A short performance by an actor or musician to show they are good for a job.
example_en: I have a big audition for a new movie role tomorrow morning.
example_uz: Ertaga yangi filmdagi rol uchun katta ko'rik sinovim bor.

definition_en: The act of deciding to stop feeling angry at someone who did something wrong.
example_en: He asked for her forgiveness after he broke her favorite glass vase.
example_uz: U sevimli vazasini sindirib qo'yganidan so'ng undan kechirim so'radi.

definition_en: A rude way to express that you are very angry or upset about something.
example_en: Dammit, I forgot to bring the keys to the house again today.
example_uz: La'nat, bugun ham uyning kalitlarini olishni unutib qo'yibman.

definition_en: An imaginary person with special physical powers who is much better than a normal human.
example_en: He thinks he is a superman who can handle all these problems alone.
example_uz: U barcha muammolarni yolg'iz o'zi hal qila oladigan sverxodamman deb o'ylaydi.

definition_en: Not treating people in an equal or honest way.
example_en: It is unfair that he got the prize instead of you.
example_uz: Mukofotni sen emas u olgani adolatsizlik.

definition_en: The people in your family who lived a long time before you were born.
example_en: My ancestors came from a small village in the mountains.
example_uz: Mening ajdodlarim tog‘dagi kichik bir qishloqdan kelishgan.

definition_en: To push food or drink down your throat into your stomach.
example_en: It is difficult to swallow when your throat is very sore.
example_uz: Tomog‘ingiz qizarib og‘riganda yutinish qiyin bo‘ladi.

definition_en: Cooked in hot oil or fat.
example_en: For breakfast, I usually eat fried eggs with a piece of toast.
example_uz: Nonushtaga odatda qovurilgan tuxum va bir bo‘lak non yeyman.

definition_en: Completely stupid or unreasonable; making no sense at all.
