example_en: It seems absurd to spend so much money on such a small thing.
example_uz: Shunchalik kichik narsaga buncha ko‘p pul sarflash juda bema‘ni ko‘rinadi.

definition_en: Attractive and healthy looking.
example_en: She was such a bonnie child with bright eyes and rosy cheeks.
example_uz: U porloq ko‘zlari va qip-qizil yonoqlari bilan juda yoqimli qizaloq edi.

definition_en: The soft grey powder that remains after something has been completely burned by fire.
example_en: We sat by the fire and watched the logs turn into ashes.
example_uz: Olov yonida o‘tirib, o‘tinlarning kulga aylanishini kuzatib o‘tirdik.

definition_en: A situation where someone does not understand the correct meaning of something or someone else.
example_en: There was a slight misunderstanding about the time of our meeting today.
example_uz: Bugungi uchrashuvimiz vaqti borasida ozgina tushunmovchilik bo‘ldi.

definition_en: The body's ability to resist a particular infection or illness through natural or medical means.
example_en: Eating healthy food helps your body develop strong immunity against common colds.
example_uz: Sog‘lom ovqatlanish tanangizda shamollashga qarshi kuchli immunitet hosil qilishga yordam beradi.

definition_en: Feeling more joy or pleasure than before.
example_en: I feel much happier since I started my new morning exercise routine.
example_uz: Ertalabki mashqlarni boshlaganimdan beri o'zimni ancha baxtliroq his qilyapman.

definition_en: A traditional title for a ruler or noble in some Central Asian countries.
example_en: The local khan built a large trading post for travelers on horses.
example_uz: Mahalliy xon otliq yo'lovchilar uchun katta savdo bekati qurdirgan.

definition_en: Painful and uncomfortable because of injury or infection.
example_en: My legs are very sore after running a long marathon yesterday morning.
example_uz: Kecha ertalab marafon yugurganimdan keyin oyoqlarim juda og'riyapti.

definition_en: In a state where you are not awake and cannot see or hear.
example_en: The doctor found the patient lying unconscious on the cold hospital floor.
example_uz: Shifokor bemorni shifoxona sovuq polida hushsiz yotgan holda topdi.

definition_en: To know someone or something because you have seen or heard them before.
example_en: I did not recognise him because he had grown a beard.
example_uz: Soqol qo'yib olgani uchun uni darrov tanimadim.

definition_en: To walk through deep water or thick mud with difficulty.
example_en: We had to wade across the shallow stream to reach the village.
example_uz: Qishloqqa yetib olish uchun biz sayoz ariqni kechib o'tishimiz kerak edi.

definition_en: A word used to refer to a man, especially an ordinary man.
example_en: He seems like a nice bloke who enjoys talking to everyone.
example_uz: U hamma bilan gaplashishni yoqtiradigan yaxshi yigitga o'xshaydi.

definition_en: To burst apart suddenly and violently with a loud noise.
example_en: The old engine began to shake and then it suddenly exploded.
example_uz: Eski dvigatel qaltiray boshladi va birdaniga portlab ketdi.

definition_en: A person whose job is to look after children in their own home.
example_en: The children love their new nanny because she plays games with them.
example_uz: Bolalar yangi enagasini yaxshi ko'rishadi chunki u ular bilan o'yin o'ynaydi.

definition_en: The stomach or the area of the body around the stomach.
example_en: He has been eating too much lately and developed a big gut.
example_uz: U oxirgi paytlari juda ko'p ovqat yedi va qorni chiqib ketdi.

definition_en: Very impressive, beautiful, or of excellent quality.
example_en: We had a splendid view of the mountains from our hotel room.
example_uz: Mehmonxona xonamizdan tog'larning ajoyib manzarasi ko'rinib turardi.

definition_en: To remove someone from their job or to decide something is unimportant.
example_en: The manager dismissed the employee for being late every single day.
example_uz: Menejer xodimni har kuni kechikkani uchun ishdan bo'shatib yubordi.

definition_en: A box-shaped container that slides into a piece of furniture for holding things.
example_en: I keep my socks and t-shirts in the bottom drawer of desk.
example_uz: Paypoq va futbolkalarimni stolning pastki tortmasida saqlayman.

definition_en: A short period of sleep, often taken during the day.
example_en: I always feel much better after a quick afternoon nap.
example_uz: Tushdan keyin qisqa muddat uxlab olsam o‘zimni ancha tetik his qilaman.

definition_en: A sound that is quiet or not clear because it is covered up.
example_en: I could hear the muffled sound of music coming from next door.
example_uz: Qo‘shni xonadan musiqa ovozi bo‘g‘iq eshitilardi.

definition_en: A man who is getting married at his wedding.
example_en: The groom looked very nervous while waiting for his bride to arrive.
example_uz: Kuyov kelinni kutayotgan paytda juda hayajonda edi.

definition_en: A group of close friends who spend time together.
example_en: My old buddies and I go to the cinema every Friday night.
example_uz: Eski do‘stlarim bilan har juma oqshom kinoga boramiz.

definition_en: To die by being underwater for too long and unable to breathe.
example_en: When I was a baby, I nearly drowned in the bathtub.
example_uz: Men yoshligimda vannada deyarli cho'kib ketayozganman.

definition_en: The state or quality of being extremely good or high in standard.
example_en: She was chosen for the award because of the excellency of her work.
example_uz: U o'z ishining yuksak sifati tufayli mukofotga loyiq ko'rildi.

definition_en: A round flat piece of cooked meat served inside a soft bread roll.
example_en: She was planning to have a burger for dinner this evening.
example_uz: U kechki ovqat uchun burger yemoqchi edi.

definition_en: A thick mixture of flour and water that is baked to make food.
example_en: Pizza dough is very stretchy when you prepare it for baking.
example_uz: Pitsa xamiri pishirishga tayyorlaganda juda cho'ziluvchan bo'ladi.

definition_en: To destroy something violently so that it cannot be used anymore.
example_en: The storm caused the wind to wreck several houses in the village.
example_uz: Bo'ron qishloqdagi bir nechta uyni vayron qildi.

definition_en: The male parent of an animal, especially a horse or cattle.
example_en: The stallion was a champion sire for many years on the farm.
example_uz: Bu aygʻir fermada koʻp yillar davomida chempion naslchi boʻlib keldi.

definition_en: Very successful, busy, or active.
example_en: The new cafe is a roaring success in the busy city center.
example_uz: Yangi kafe gavjum shahar markazida juda muvaffaqiyatli ishlamoqda.

definition_en: To push a sharp or pointed object into someone or something.
example_en: He had to stab the steak with his knife to cut it.
example_uz: U bifshternsni kesish uchun pichoq bilan sanchishi kerak edi.

definition_en: A soft, high-pitched sound made when a person or animal is crying or afraid.
example_en: I could hear the soft whimpering of the puppy under the bed.
example_uz: Krovat tagidan kuchukchaning past ovozda ingrashini eshitdim.

definition_en: An event that causes public outrage because it offends moral or ethical standards.
example_en: The political scandal made headlines in all the newspapers yesterday.
example_uz: Siyosiy janjal kecha barcha gazetalarning sarlavhasiga aylandi.

definition_en: To have a very strong and unpleasant smell.
example_en: The old trash in the kitchen began to stink after a day.
example_uz: Oshxonadagi eski axlat bir kundan keyin badboʻy hid tarata boshladi.

definition_en: A home run in the sport of baseball.
example_en: The crowd cheered wildly when the player hit his second homer.
example_uz: Oʻyinchi ikkinchi marta xomer urganida tomoshabinlar juda xursand boʻlishdi.

definition_en: An informal way to say goodbye to someone.
example_en: Tara for now, I will see you on Monday morning!
example_uz: Xayr hozircha, dushanba kuni ertalab koʻrishamiz!

definition_en: A person who fires a gun or other weapon, especially in a crime or sport.
example_en: The police were looking for the shooter who escaped from the scene.
example_uz: Politsiya voqea joyidan qochib ketgan o'q uzuvchini qidirmoqda edi.

definition_en: A practice or trial of a performance before it is presented to an audience.
example_en: We have a final rehearsal before the concert starts this evening.
example_uz: Konsert boshlanishidan oldin bizda yakuniy mashq bor.

definition_en: Food or a fake item used to attract fish or animals into a trap.
example_en: The fisherman carefully put the bait on the hook before casting out.
example_uz: Baliqchi qarmoqni suvga tashlashdan oldin ehtiyotkorlik bilan yemni ilib qo'ydi.

definition_en: The quality of being worthy of respect and acting in a calm, serious way.
example_en: She faced her difficult problems with great dignity and strength of character.
example_uz: U o'zining qiyin muammolarini yuksak qadr-qimmat va matonat bilan qarshi oldi.

definition_en: A very addictive and illegal drug that is made from opium.
example_en: Addiction to heroin ruins lives and affects the safety of our communities.
example_uz: Geroinga qaramlik inson hayotini barbod qiladi va jamiyatimiz xavfsizligiga ta'sir ko'rsatadi.

definition_en: Not proud; showing that you do not think you are better than other people.
example_en: Despite his great success, he remains a humble and kind person.
example_uz: Katta yutuqlarga erishganiga qaramay u hamon kamtar va mehribon inson.

definition_en: To cause someone to admire or respect you because of your skills or qualities.
example_en: Your ability to speak three languages really impressed the interview team.
example_uz: Uchta tilda gapira olish qobiliyatingiz suhbat hay'atini haqiqatan ham hayratlantirdi.

definition_en: To say that you will hurt or punish someone if they do not do something.
example_en: The criminals tried to threaten the shopkeeper to get his money.
example_uz: Jinoyatchilar do'kondorning pulini olish uchun uni qo'rqitishga harakat qilishdi.

definition_en: To hit something by accident while you are moving.
example_en: I was walking in the dark and bumped into the closed door.
example_uz: Qorong'uda yurib, yopiq eshikka urilib ketdim.

definition_en: All human beings considered as a single group.
example_en: The discovery of fire changed the entire course of history for mankind.
example_uz: Olovning kashf etilishi insoniyat tarixini butunlay o'zgartirib yubordi.

definition_en: To look at someone or something for a long time without looking away.
example_en: It is rude to stare at people when you are in public.
example_uz: Jamoat joylarida odamlarga tikilib qarash odobsizlik hisoblanadi.

definition_en: A small, simple house made of wood, mud, or other natural materials.
example_en: The fishermen lived in a small wooden hut near the sea.
example_uz: Baliqchilar dengiz bo'yidagi kichik yog'och kulbada yashashardi.

definition_en: A deep state of unconsciousness from which a person cannot be woken up.
example_en: The patient has been in a coma since the serious car accident.
example_uz: Bemor jiddiy avtohalokatdan beri komada yotibdi.

definition_en: A wooden or metal box used to bury a dead person's body.
example_en: The family followed the coffin as it was carried to the grave.
example_uz: Oila a'zolari tobutni qabrga olib ketilayotganda ortidan ergashdilar.

definition_en: A powerful and illegal drug that makes people feel energetic and very excited.
example_en: The police seized a large amount of cocaine during the raid yesterday.
example_uz: Kecha reyd davomida politsiya katta miqdordagi kokainni musodara qildi.

definition_en: Having more sound or volume than before.
example_en: Please speak a little louder so everyone can hear you clearly.
example_uz: Iltimos, hamma eshitishi uchun biroz balandroq gapiring.

definition_en: A very serious and formal promise to tell the truth or be loyal.
example_en: The new president took an oath to serve the people faithfully.
example_uz: Yangi prezident xalqqa sadoqat bilan xizmat qilishga qasam ichdi.

definition_en: A large and noisy crowd of people who may be behaving in a violent way.
example_en: An angry mob gathered in the street to protest the new law.
example_uz: Ko‘chada yangi qonunga qarshi namoyish o‘tkazish uchun g‘azablangan olomon yig‘ildi.

definition_en: A medical examination of a dead body to discover the cause of death.
example_en: The autopsy revealed that the victim had died of natural causes.
example_uz: Tibbiy ekspertiza marhumning tabiiy sabablarga ko‘ra vafot etganini aniqladi.

definition_en: Very thin, often in a way that is not healthy or attractive.
example_en: He has been very skinny since he started working long hours.
example_uz: U ko‘p ishlay boshlaganidan beri juda ozib ketdi.

definition_en: Feeling happy because something unpleasant has stopped or did not happen.
example_en: She felt relieved when the doctor said her test results were fine.
example_uz: Shifokor tahlil natijalari yaxshi ekanini aytganida, uning ko‘ngli ko‘tarildi.

definition_en: Very cute and easy to like or love.
example_en: That is an adorable little puppy you have in your arms.
example_uz: Qo‘lingizdagi kuchukcha juda yoqimtoy ekan.

definition_en: Words used to say that you are sorry for something you did wrong.
example_en: Please accept my apologies for being late to our meeting today.
example_uz: Bugungi uchrashuvga kechikkanim uchun uzrimni qabul qiling.

definition_en: A professional person who provides guidance and support for personal or emotional problems.
example_en: The school counselor helped the student choose the right university subjects.
example_uz: Maktab maslahatchisi o'quvchiga to'g'ri fanlarni tanlashda yordam berdi.

definition_en: Covered with small round marks of a different color than the background surface.
example_en: The spotted leopard was hiding behind the trees in the jungle.
example_uz: Dog'li qoplon o'rmondagi daraxtlar ortida yashiringan edi.

definition_en: To remove hair from the face or body using a razor.
example_en: Most men shave their faces every morning before going to work.
example_uz: Ko'pchilik erkaklar ishga borishdan oldin har kuni ertalab soqol oladi.

definition_en: To throw something lightly or casually in a particular direction.
example_en: Toss it over here so I can see what you have.
example_uz: Menga nima olib kelganingni ko'rishim uchun uni bu yoqqa irgitib yubor.

definition_en: A layer of dirty or unpleasant material that forms on the surface of a liquid.
example_en: During smelting, scum rises to the surface and is then removed by the smelter.
example_uz: Eritish jarayonida ko'pik yuzaga chiqadi va u keyin ishchi tomonidan tozalanadi.

definition_en: The act of laughing in a silly, high-pitched, or nervous way.
example_en: The children were giggling during the lesson when the teacher walked in.
example_uz: O'qituvchi kirib kelganda bolalar dars paytida qiqirlab o'tirishardi.

definition_en: A word used to show surprise, frustration, or annoyance.
example_en: Geez, that was one heck of a long week at work.
example_uz: Voy, ishda haftam juda og'ir o'tdi.

definition_en: A state of feeling very unhappy, distressed, or full of pain.
example_en: Ever since his wife left him you can see the misery on his face.
example_uz: Xotini tashlab ketganidan beri uning yuzida iztirobni ko'rish mumkin.

definition_en: Staying loyal to a person or idea and supporting them over a long time.
example_en: My dog is very faithful; he stays by my side every day.
example_uz: Itim juda vafodor; u har kuni yonginamdan ketmaydi.

definition_en: To speak to someone in a threatening or bossy way to make them do something.
example_en: The manager should not hector his employees during the morning team meeting.
example_uz: Menejer ertalabki yig'ilishda xodimlariga dag'dag'a qilmasligi kerak.

definition_en: A strong feeling such as happiness, love, fear, or anger.
example_en: She found it hard to control her emotion during the sad movie.
example_uz: G'amgin kinoni ko'rayotganda u o'z hislarini jilovlashga qiynaldi.

definition_en: An informal way to refer to a man.
example_en: Who is that friendly chap standing near the door over there?
example_uz: Eshik yonida turgan u xushmuomala yigit kim?

definition_en: Very bad, poor quality, or generally unpleasant.
example_en: I had a really shitty day at work yesterday, honestly.
example_uz: Kecha ishda kunim juda yomon o'tdi, rostini aytsam.

definition_en: The firm pink flesh inside your mouth that surrounds the teeth.
example_en: My gum started to hurt after I ate that hard candy.
example_uz: Qattiq konfetni yeganimdan keyin miligim og'riy boshladi.

definition_en: Relating to the physical human body.
example_en: In the past, corporal punishment was common in many schools.
example_uz: Ilgari ko'plab maktablarda jismoniy jazo keng tarqalgan edi.

definition_en: Feeling that there is no chance that a situation will improve.
example_en: He felt hopeless about finding a new job after months trying.
example_uz: Bir necha oy urinib ham yangi ish topa olmagach, u umidsizlikka tushdi.

definition_en: To become larger in size or volume.
example_en: Your ankle will swell up if you do not rest it.
example_uz: Agar dam olmasangiz, to'pig'ingiz shishib ketadi.

definition_en: A very large, special meal prepared to celebrate a particular event.
example_en: We had a grand feast to celebrate the end of the harvest.
example_uz: Hosil bayrami sharafiga katta ziyofat uyushtirdik.

definition_en: A sound made to clear the throat, used to get someone's attention.
example_en: Ahem! Could we please get started with the meeting now?
example_uz: Xax! Majlisni boshlasak bo'ladimi?

definition_en: Wild animals that look like large dogs and live in groups.
example_en: The pack of wolves hunted together through the deep forest.
example_uz: Bo'rilar to'dasi qalin o'rmon ichida birga ov qildi.

definition_en: An informal way to say 'I do not know'.
example_en: Where did he go? I dunno, he left without saying anything.
example_uz: U qayerga ketdi? Bilmayman, hech narsa demasdan chiqib ketdi.

definition_en: A feeling of deep sadness or unhappiness, often after losing something.
example_en: She felt great sorrow when she heard the sad news.
example_uz: U bu qayg'uli xabarni eshitgach, qattiq g'am chekdi.

definition_en: A permanent mark left on the skin after a wound has finished healing.
example_en: He has a small scar on his forehead from a childhood accident.
example_uz: U bolaligidagi baxtsiz hodisadan keyin peshonasida kichik chandiq qolgan.

definition_en: Unnecessary excitement or activity, often about something that is not important.
example_en: The staff made a big fuss about the surprise party arrangements.
example_uz: Xodimlar syurpriz ziyofatni tashkil etishda juda ko'p shov-shuv ko'tarishdi.

definition_en: Not as good at a skill as before because you have not practiced recently.
example_en: My French is a bit rusty because I haven't practiced in years.
example_uz: Fransuz tilim biroz eskirib qolibdi, chunki yillar davomida shug'ullanmadim.

definition_en: A person who behaves in a very strange or dangerous way.
example_en: He drives like a total psycho when he is late for work.
example_uz: Ishga kech qolganda u xuddi jinni kabi haydaydi.

definition_en: Having more intelligence or being better at learning than someone else.
example_en: You may be faster than me, but I am smarter than you.
example_uz: Mendan ko'ra tezroq yugurishing mumkin, lekin men sendan aqlliroqman.

definition_en: To push someone or something with force, often in a rough way.
example_en: The crowd began to shove and push to get out the door.
example_uz: Eshikdan chiqish uchun olomon bir-birini itara boshladi.

definition_en: Not interesting or exciting at all.
example_en: He sat through the dull lecture and barely stayed awake.
example_uz: U zerikarli ma'ruzada o'tirib zo'rg'a uyg'oq qoldi.

definition_en: Having no value or use.
example_en: Don’t be a worthless slouch! Go get yourself a job.
example_uz: Bekorchidan bo'lib yuraverma! Borib o'zingga ish top.

definition_en: The quality of being generous, helpful, and caring towards other people.
example_en: Jamie's kindness is legendary, so much that people have taken advantage of her.
example_uz: Jeymining mehribonligi afsonaga aylangan, odamlar hatto undan foydalanib ketishadi.

definition_en: Information that people are talking about that may not be true.
example_en: There's a rumor going round that he's going to get married.
example_uz: U uylanmoqchi degan mish-mish tarqaldi.

definition_en: A long, thin, pointed piece of metal or wood.
example_en: The trap was lined with spikes.
example_uz: Qopqonning ichi o'tkir shixlar bilan to'ldirilgan edi.

definition_en: A hot-tasting root used as a spice in cooking or drinks.
example_en: I always add fresh ginger to my tea when I feel sick.
example_uz: Shamollab qolganimda choyimga doim yangi zanjabil qo'shaman.

definition_en: A polite way to ask someone to do something.
example_en: Could you kindly wait for a few minutes while I finish work?
example_uz: Ishimni tugatgunimcha iltimos bir necha daqiqa kutib tura olasizmi?

definition_en: To feel unhappy because you want something that someone else has.
example_en: I sometimes envy my sister because she travels to many beautiful countries.
example_uz: Ba'zan singlimga havasim keladi, chunki u juda ko'p chiroyli davlatlarga boradi.

definition_en: The positive aspect or advantage of a situation that might otherwise be bad.
example_en: The upside of moving abroad is that you learn a new language.
example_uz: Chet elga ko'chib o'tishning yaxshi tarafi shundaki, siz yangi til o'rganasiz.

definition_en: Feeling extremely worried and believing that other people are trying to harm you.
example_en: He became paranoid that his coworkers were talking about him behind back.
example_uz: U hamkasblari ortidan g'iybat qilayotganidan haddan tashqari shubhalanadigan bo'lib qoldi.

definition_en: Not clear, bright, or strong; difficult to see, hear, or smell.
example_en: We saw a faint light glowing in the distance late at night.
example_uz: Kechasi uzoqda xira yorug'lik porlayotganini ko'rdik.

definition_en: To lose blood from your body because of an injury.
example_en: If you cut your finger, it will probably bleed for a while.
example_uz: Agar barmog'ingizni kesib olsangiz, bir oz vaqt qon oqishi mumkin.

definition_en: To say that something is not allowed or must not be done.
example_en: The rules forbid students from using their mobile phones during the exam.
example_uz: Qoidalar imtihon paytida talabalarga mobil telefonlardan foydalanishni taqiqlaydi.

definition_en: Tidy, clean, and in good order.
example_en: She keeps her desk very neat and organized at all times.
example_uz: U o‘z ish stolini doimo ozoda va tartibli saqlaydi.

definition_en: A person who claims to have special powers to know things beyond normal human senses.
example_en: Some people believe that a psychic can predict the future with accuracy.
example_uz: Ba'zi odamlar ekstrasens kelajakni aniq bashorat qila oladi deb ishonishadi.

definition_en: A large water bird with a long neck that is bigger than a duck.
example_en: There is a flock of geese swimming on the village pond today.
example_uz: Bugun qishloq ko‘lida bir to‘da g‘oz suzib yuribdi.

definition_en: Happening by chance or without being intended.
example_en: I accidentally left my keys inside the house this morning.
example_uz: Bugun ertalab tasodifan kalitlarimni uyda unutib qoldirdim.

definition_en: To clean a floor or surface using a broom.
example_en: Could you please sweep the kitchen floor after you finish cooking?
example_uz: Ovqat pishirib bo‘lganingizdan keyin oshxona polini supurib qo‘ya olasizmi?

definition_en: To demand money or favors by threatening to reveal someone's secrets.
example_en: The criminal tried to blackmail the businessman by using private photos.
example_uz: Jinoyatchi shaxsiy suratlardan foydalanib, tadbirkorni shantaj qilishga urindi.

definition_en: Involving the possibility of something bad or dangerous happening.
example_en: It is very risky to drive on these icy roads at night.
example_uz: Kechasi muzlagan yo‘llarda mashina haydash juda xatarli.

definition_en: Very beautiful, pleasant, or causing great pride and success.
example_en: We spent a glorious day walking in the mountains under the sun.
example_uz: Quyosh ostida tog‘larda sayr qilib, juda muhtasham kun o‘tkazdik.

definition_en: A very strong feeling of not liking someone or something at all.
example_en: There is a lot of hatred between the two groups of people.
example_uz: Bu ikki guruh odamlari o‘rtasida katta nafrat bor.

definition_en: To stop something from being successful or from happening.
example_en: The bad weather scotched our plans to go to the beach.
example_uz: Yomon ob-havo plyajga borish rejalarimizni barbod qildi.

definition_en: An animal that is hunted and killed for food by another animal.
example_en: The lion waited in the grass to catch its unsuspecting prey.
example_uz: Sher o‘zining bexabar o‘ljasini tutish uchun o‘tlar orasida poylab yotdi.

definition_en: To cook food in hot oil or fat.
example_en: I need to fry the onions before adding them to the soup.
example_uz: Piyozlarni sho‘rvaga qo‘shishdan oldin qovurib olishim kerak.

definition_en: The person who is in charge of a prison.
example_en: The prison warden ordered the guards to lock all the heavy doors.
example_uz: Qamoqxona boshlig'i soqchilarga barcha og'ir eshiklarni qulflashni buyurdi.

definition_en: A dead person brought back to life in horror stories who eats people.
example_en: We watched a scary movie about a zombie attack in a big city.
example_uz: Biz katta shahardagi zombi hujumi haqida qo'rqinchli kino ko'rdik.

definition_en: A kind remark that expresses approval or admiration for someone.
example_en: It is a great compliment when someone tells you that you look good.
example_uz: Kimdir sizga chiroyli ekanligingizni aytsa, bu katta maqtovdir.

definition_en: Unable to act or protect yourself without the help of other people.
example_en: The tiny kitten felt helpless when it was left in the rain.
example_uz: Kichkina mushukcha yomgʻirda qolib ketganda oʻzini ojiz his qildi.

definition_en: A natural desire or interest to eat food or do something.
example_en: A long walk in the fresh air always gives me a good appetite.
example_uz: Toza havoda uzoq sayr qilish har doim ishtahamni ochadi.

definition_en: Unsuccessful or without any value or purpose.
example_en: He made a vain attempt to change her mind about the decision.
example_uz: U qarorini oʻzgartirishga majbur qilish uchun qilgan urinishlari besamar ketdi.

definition_en: To stop working, usually because you have reached a particular age.
example_en: My grandfather plans to retire from his job next year at sixty.
example_uz: Bobom kelasi yili oltmish yoshida ishdan nafaqaga chiqmoqchi.

definition_en: Feeling extremely happy, excited, and pleased about something.
example_en: Ben was thrilled to lead the game in front of his fans.
example_uz: Ben muxlislar qarshisida o'yinni boshqarganidan juda xursand edi.

definition_en: A person who is not smart and often says or does silly things.
example_en: Stop acting like a dummy and listen to the teacher carefully.
example_uz: Ahmoqqa o'xshab qiliq qilmang va o'qituvchiga diqqat bilan quloq soling.

definition_en: A person who works on ships or is skilled at sailing.
example_en: He is a talented sailor and has spent many years at sea.
example_uz: U mohir dengizchi va ko'p yillarini dengizda o'tkazgan.

definition_en: An informal and friendly way to say hello to someone.
example_en: Hiya, how are things going with your new job today?
example_uz: Salom, yangi ishingdagi ishlar qalay bo'lyapti?

definition_en: A member of a powerful military class in ancient Japanese society.
example_en: The samurai were known for their strict code of honor and discipline.
example_uz: Samuraylar o'zlarining qat'iy sharaf va intizom kodekslari bilan tanilgan.

definition_en: Traveling from place to place without a permanent home.
example_en: The wandering minstrel sang songs of old battles in every village.
example_uz: Kezib yuruvchi hofiz har bir qishloqda qadimiy janglar haqida qo‘shiq kuylardi.

definition_en: A person whose job is to cut and sell raw meat.
example_en: The butcher prepared a fresh cut of beef for the family dinner.
example_uz: Qassob oilaviy kechki ovqat uchun yangi mol go‘shtini tayyorlab berdi.

definition_en: A strong alcoholic drink made from fermented fruit juice or wine.
example_en: He enjoyed sipping a glass of brandy by the fireplace at night.
example_uz: U kechqurun o‘choq yonida bir qadah konyak ichib o‘tirishni yoqtirardi.

definition_en: To say that you are sorry for doing something wrong.
example_en: You should apologise to your friend for being late to the party.
example_uz: Kechana kechikkaning uchun do‘stingdan uzr so‘rashing kerak.

definition_en: A member of a fascist political party that controlled Germany during the second world war.
example_en: History students often read about the crimes committed by the nazi regime.
example_uz: Tarix talabalari ko'pincha natsistlar rejimi sodir etgan jinoyatlar haqida o'qishadi.

definition_en: Permission for a prisoner to leave prison early if they behave well.
example_en: After serving ten years, he was finally released on parole.
example_uz: O'n yil jazoni o'tagach u nihoyat shartli ravishda ozod qilindi.

definition_en: A small gun that is designed to be held and fired with one hand.
example_en: The police officer pulled out his pistol to stop the suspect.
example_uz: Politsiyachi gumondorni to'xtatish uchun to'pponchasini chiqardi.

definition_en: Happening because of good luck; used to say that something is good.
example_en: Fortunately, the rain stopped just before our outdoor wedding ceremony began.
example_uz: Xayriyatki to'y marosimimiz boshlanishidan oldin yomg'ir to'xtadi.

definition_en: An informal way to say I understand or I caught you by surprise.
example_en: Gotcha! I knew you were hiding behind that large oak tree.
example_uz: Ushlab oldim! Seni o'sha katta eman daraxti orqasida yashiringaningni bilardim.

definition_en: A stone structure or room where a dead person is buried.
example_en: Tourists visited the ancient tomb to see the historic wall paintings.
example_uz: Sayyohlar qadimiy maqbaradagi tarixiy devoriy suratlarni ko'rish uchun tashrif buyurishdi.

definition_en: A person trained in secret fighting methods, often wearing black clothes.
example_en: The movie featured a skilled ninja fighting enemies in the night.
example_uz: Filmda tunda dushmanlar bilan jang qiladigan mohir nindzya tasvirlangan.

definition_en: Time that has no end or a period of time that seems very long.
example_en: They promised to love each other for all of eternity.
example_uz: Ular bir-birini abadiyatgacha sevishga va'da berishdi.

definition_en: To move slowly on your hands and knees or by dragging your body.
example_en: The baby started to crawl across the floor to reach its toy.
example_uz: Chaqaloq o‘yinchoqqa yetish uchun polda emaklay boshladi.

definition_en: A thin and flat piece of food cut from a larger piece.
example_en: Would you like another slice of bread with your soup?
example_uz: Sho‘rvangiz bilan yana bir tilim non xohlaysizmi?

definition_en: The way in which a person or animal acts or behaves.
example_en: The teacher praised the children for their good behaviour today.
example_uz: O‘qituvchi bolalarni bugungi yaxshi xulqi uchun maqtadi.

definition_en: Not easily bent or changed in shape; difficult to move.
example_en: My neck is very stiff after sitting at the computer all day.
example_uz: Kuni bilan kompyuterda o‘tirganim uchun bo‘ynim qotib qoldi.

definition_en: To move your tongue over the surface of something.
example_en: The dog ran up to lick my face in excitement.
example_uz: It quvonib yuzimni yalash uchun yugurib keldi.

definition_en: The name of God in the Islamic religion.
example_en: He thanked Allah for the strength to overcome his difficulties.
example_uz: U qiyinchiliklarni yengish uchun kuch bergani uchun Allohga shukr qildi.

definition_en: A tube of ground meat or other ingredients wrapped in a thin skin.
example_en: We grilled some sausages for dinner in the garden yesterday.
example_uz: Biz kecha bog‘da kechki ovqat uchun sosiska qovurdik.

definition_en: A police officer of the lowest rank in certain English-speaking countries.
example_en: The local constable patrolled the streets every evening to ensure public safety.
example_uz: Hududiy politsiyachi jamoat tartibini ta'minlash uchun har oqshom ko'chalarni nazorat qildi.

definition_en: The action or process of turning round and round quickly.
example_en: The spinning of the wheels made a loud noise on the road.
example_uz: G'ildiraklarning tez aylanishi yo'lda baland shovqin chiqardi.

definition_en: Making a lot of sound or noise.
example_en: He spoke loudly so that his friend could hear him clearly.
example_uz: Do'sti uni aniq eshitishi uchun u baland ovozda gapirdi.

definition_en: Extremely good or enjoyable; causing great wonder.
example_en: We had a marvelous time at the park during our weekend holiday.
example_uz: Dam olish kunlari bog'da juda ajoyib vaqt o'tkazdik.

definition_en: An underground electric railway system used for city transportation.
example_en: It is much faster to travel by subway during the busy morning.
example_uz: Tirband tong paytida metroda harakatlanish ancha tezroq.

definition_en: To move slowly and quietly to avoid being noticed by other people.
example_en: The thief tried to creep past the guard without making any sound.
example_uz: O'g'ri hech qanday tovush chiqarmay qo'riqchining yonidan o'tib ketishga urindi.

definition_en: A feeling of liking or love for someone or something.
example_en: She showed great affection for her younger brother during the long trip.
example_uz: U uzoq safar davomida ukasiga nisbatan katta mehr ko'rsatdi.

definition_en: Made of wood or having the texture and appearance of wood.
example_en: The plant has a thick woody stem that supports its flowers.
example_uz: O'simlikning gullarini tutib turadigan qalin yog'ochsimon poyasi bor.

definition_en: An adult male duck.
example_en: The drake has much more colorful feathers than the female duck.
example_uz: Erkak o'rdak urg'ochisiga qaraganda ancha yorqin patlarga ega.

definition_en: Used to finish a previous subject or show that something is true despite other facts.
example_en: I am not sure if he heard me; anyhow, it does not matter.
example_uz: U meni eshitganmi yo'qmi bilmayman; har holda, buning ahamiyati yo'q.

definition_en: A pleasant or distinctive smell that something gives off.
example_en: The garden was filled with the sweet scent of blooming roses.
example_uz: Bog' ochilib turgan atirgullarning shirin ifori bilan to'lgan edi.

definition_en: Lacking experience of life and trusting people too easily.
example_en: It was naive of me to believe that everything would go perfectly.
example_uz: Hamma narsa mukammal bo'lishiga ishonishim soddaligimdan edi.

definition_en: The natural light from the sun that we see during the day.
example_en: We should finish the work before daylight starts to fade away.
example_uz: Ishni kun yorug'i so'nmasdan oldin tugatib olishimiz kerak.

definition_en: Very happy, cheerful, and full of energy.
example_en: The jolly old man greeted everyone with a big smile.
example_uz: Quvnoq chol hammaga katta tabassum bilan salom berdi.

definition_en: Past tense of promise in a very serious or formal way.
example_en: He swore that he had nothing to do with the robbery.
example_uz: U o‘g‘rilikka aloqasi yo‘qligiga qasam ichdi.

definition_en: Making a very loud and unpleasant sound.
example_en: The radio was blaring music in the middle of the night.
example_uz: Tun yarmida radio musiqa qichqirib turgandi.

definition_en: A sound made to express that you are annoyed or frustrated.
example_en: Argh! I have lost my keys again, this is so annoying.
example_uz: Obbo! Yana kalitlarimni yo‘qotib qo‘ydim, rosa asabiy bo‘lyapman.

definition_en: Disappeared suddenly and could not be seen anymore.
example_en: The magician vanished before our eyes in a cloud of smoke.
example_uz: Sehrgar tutun ichida ko‘z oldimizda g‘oyib bo‘ldi.

definition_en: A minor illness where your nose is runny and you keep breathing noisily.
example_en: I think I am getting the sniffles after walking in the rain.
example_uz: Yomg‘irda yurib, shekilli, tumov bo‘lib qolyapman.

definition_en: A dangerous disease that spreads quickly and kills many people.
example_en: The plague killed many people in Europe during the Middle Ages.
example_uz: O‘rta asrlarda Yevropada o‘lat ko‘p odamlarning yostig‘ini quritgan.

definition_en: A very light and gentle wind that feels nice.
example_en: A cool breeze blew across the garden on the hot day.
example_uz: Issiq kunda bog‘ bo‘ylab salqin shabada esib turardi.

definition_en: A person, especially a child, who behaves badly in a funny or annoying way.
example_en: Stop jumping on the sofa, you little rascal, and sit down now.
example_uz: Divanda sakrashni bas qil qitimir bola va joyingga o'tir.

definition_en: To make someone quiet or to become silent for a short time.
example_en: The teacher had to hush the class before starting the new lesson.
example_uz: O'qituvchi yangi darsni boshlashdan oldin sinfni tinchitishi kerak edi.

definition_en: A natural way of behaving or feeling without needing to think about it first.
example_en: Most animals follow their instinct to protect their babies from any danger.
example_uz: Ko'pchilik hayvonlar o'z bolalarini xavfdan asrash uchun instinktga tayanadi.

definition_en: Extremely angry or involving very great energy and violence.
example_en: My brother was absolutely furious when I broke his new smartphone screen.
example_uz: Akam yangi smartfoni ekranini sindirib qo'yganimda juda qattiq g'azablandi.

definition_en: To run away from a place or situation of danger.
example_en: The villagers fled their homes when the fire started spreading quickly.
example_uz: Yong'in tez tarqala boshlagach qishloq odamlari uylarini tashlab qochishdi.

definition_en: A feeling that someone has done something wrong or illegal.
example_en: The police had a strong suspicion that he was involved in the crime.
example_uz: Politsiyada uning jinoyatga aloqador ekanligi haqida kuchli gumon bor edi.

definition_en: Doing something without other people knowing about it.
example_en: She was secretly planning a surprise party for her best friend.
example_uz: U eng yaqin do'sti uchun yashirincha bayram uyushtirmoqda edi.

definition_en: Something that is difficult to do or deal with.
example_en: Learning to speak a new language can be a tricky task.
example_uz: Yangi tilni o'rganish murakkab vazifa bo'lishi mumkin.

definition_en: A vehicle pulled by horses used to carry people in the past.
example_en: The royal family arrived at the castle in a golden carriage.
example_uz: Qirollik oilasi qasrga tilla rangli faytonda yetib keldi.

definition_en: A room or storage space located completely or partly under a building.
example_en: We keep the jars of preserved vegetables down in the cellar.
example_uz: Biz konservalangan sabzavotlarni yerto'lada saqlaymiz.

definition_en: A living being that must eventually die and is not immortal.
example_en: All human beings are mortal and will face the end eventually.
example_uz: Barcha insonlar o'luvchi va oxir-oqibat o'limga yuz tutadi.

definition_en: The quality of telling the truth and not stealing or cheating.
example_en: Honesty is the most important quality in a good friendship.
example_uz: Yaxshi do'stlikda halollik eng muhim fazilat hisoblanadi.

definition_en: A brave or important action that a person does.
example_en: One small good deed can make a big difference to someone.
example_uz: Kichik bir yaxshi ish kimdir uchun katta o'zgarish yasashi mumkin.

definition_en: A criminal who steals from ships at sea or copies protected digital work illegally.
example_en: The authorities are working hard to stop pirates from attacking merchant ships.
example_uz: Rasmiylar qaroqchilarning savdo kemalariga hujum qilishini to'xtatish uchun astoydil harakat qilmoqda.

definition_en: Something that seems to be real but is not what it appears to be.
example_en: The desert heat created an illusion of water on the distant road.
example_uz: Sahrodagi issiq olis yo'lda suv bor degan aldamchi tasavvurni uyg'otdi.

definition_en: A small, dark, or raised spot on a person's skin.
example_en: She has a small mole on her left cheek that looks beautiful.
example_uz: Uning chap yuzida chiroyli ko'rinadigan kichkina xoli bor.

definition_en: Past tense of ring; to make a phone call to someone.
example_en: He rang his mother to tell her he arrived home safely.
example_uz: U uyiga yetib kelganini aytish uchun onasiga qo'ng'iroq qildi.

definition_en: A person who will legally receive money, property, or a title from someone.
example_en: The king's eldest son is the official heir to the throne.
example_uz: Qirolning to'ng'ich o'g'li taxtning rasmiy merosxo'ri hisoblanadi.

definition_en: A person qualified to treat the diseases and conditions that affect the teeth.
example_en: I need to visit the dentist because one of my teeth hurts.
example_uz: Tishim og'riganligi uchun tish shifokoriga borishim kerak.

definition_en: To cook food, especially meat, in an oven or over a fire.
example_en: We like to roast a large chicken for our Sunday family dinner.
example_uz: Biz yakshanba kungi oilaviy kechki ovqat uchun tovuqni pechda pishirishni yoqtiramiz.

definition_en: A very large and expensive house where wealthy people live.
example_en: They live in a beautiful white mansion on the hill outside town.
example_uz: Ular shahardan tashqaridagi qirlikda joylashgan go‘zal oq qasrda yashashadi.

definition_en: A polite way to address an unmarried French-speaking woman.
example_en: Excuse me mademoiselle, did you drop your umbrella on the sidewalk?
example_uz: Kechirasiz mademuazel, siz soyaboningizni yo‘lakka tushirib qo‘ymadingizmi?

definition_en: A place where people believe ghosts or spirits live or appear.
example_en: Many people say that the old abandoned house is truly haunted.
example_uz: Ko‘pchilik bu tashlandiq eski uyda haqiqatan ham arvohlar bor deyishadi.

definition_en: Unable to pay attention because your mind is thinking about something else.
example_en: I was so distracted by the noise that I forgot my keys.
example_uz: Shovqindan shunchalik chalg‘ib qoldimki, hatto kalitlarimni ham unutibman.

definition_en: An informal word for someone who is the best at a sport.
example_en: You worked so hard today, you are a real champ my friend.
example_uz: Bugun juda qattiq ishlading, sen haqiqiy chempionsan do‘stim.

definition_en: A long gun that fires a large number of small metal balls at one time.
example_en: The hunter carried his shotgun while walking through the thick forest trees.
example_uz: Ovchi o'rmon ichida yurganida ov miltig'ini o'zi bilan olib yurdi.

definition_en: Feeling as if you are turning around and may fall down.
example_en: I stood up too fast from the chair and felt quite dizzy.
example_uz: Stuldan juda tez turganim uchun biroz boshim aylanib ketdi.

definition_en: Someone who hurts or frightens people who are weaker than themselves.
example_en: The school bully was finally punished for bothering the smaller children.
example_uz: Maktab bezorisi oxiri kichik bolalarni bezovta qilgani uchun jazolandi.

definition_en: A round, flat piece of ground meat or vegetables prepared for eating.
example_en: The cook fried the hamburger patty, then put it in a bun.
example_uz: Oshpaz kotletni qovurib, so‘ng uni bulochkaning ichiga soldi.

definition_en: Having a large amount of money, property, or valuable possessions.
example_en: She comes from a wealthy family that owns several large companies.
example_uz: U bir nechta yirik kompaniyalarga ega bo‘lgan badavlat oiladan chiqqan.

definition_en: To slowly decay or be destroyed by natural processes.
example_en: The apple left in the cupboard all that time had started to rot.
example_uz: Shkafda qolib ketgan olma chiriy boshlagan edi.

definition_en: To accidentally let a liquid flow over the edge of its container.
example_en: I accidentally spilled some hot tea on the kitchen floor.
example_uz: Men beixtiyor oshxona poliga issiq choy to‘kib yubordim.

definition_en: Someone who has died and is no longer alive.
example_en: The deceased person left all of his money to the local hospital.
example_uz: Marhum bor merosini mahalliy kasalxonaga qoldirdi.

definition_en: Feeling tired and wanting to sleep.
example_en: I feel very sleepy after a long day of working at school.
example_uz: Maktabda uzoq ishlaganimdan keyin juda uyqum kelyapti.

definition_en: Having complete power over everything.
example_en: Many people pray to the almighty God for guidance and peace.
example_uz: Ko‘pchilik hidoyat va tinchlik so‘rab qodir Allohga iltijo qiladi.

definition_en: A state of feeling ashamed or causing others to lose respect for you.
example_en: His rude behavior at the dinner party was a complete disgrace.
example_uz: Tushlikdagi qo‘pol xulqi chinakam sharmandalik bo‘ldi.

definition_en: To make a loud, high, and unpleasant sound.
example_en: The car tires began to screech when he hit the brakes hard.
example_uz: U tormozni keskin bosganda, mashina shinalari chirillay boshladi.

definition_en: A small amount of food eaten between main meals.
example_en: I usually have a healthy snack like an apple in the afternoon.
example_uz: Men odatda tushdan keyin olma kabi foydali tamaddi qilaman.

definition_en: A small mark or shallow dent on the surface of something.
example_en: There is a small ding on the side of my new car.
example_uz: Yangi mashinamning yon tomonida kichkina tirnalgan joyi bor.

definition_en: The soft part of the face on either side of the nose.
example_en: The cold wind made her cheeks turn bright red.
example_uz: Sovuq shamol yuzlarini qip-qizil qilib qo'ydi.

definition_en: To get rid of something or stop being with someone.
example_en: I decided to ditch my old clothes and buy some new ones.
example_uz: Eski kiyimlarimdan voz kechib, yangilarini sotib olishga qaror qildim.

definition_en: A small American or Canadian coin that is worth ten cents.
example_en: He did not have a single dime in his pocket.
example_uz: Cho'ntagida hatto o'n sent puli ham yo'q edi.

definition_en: To laugh quietly, often because you are thinking about something funny.
example_en: She chuckled when she saw the puppy playing in the yard.
example_uz: Hovlida o'ynayotgan kuchukchani ko'rib, u ichida kulib qo'ydi.

definition_en: Money that is paid to free someone who has been captured.
example_en: The kidnappers demanded a large ransom for the boy's release.
example_uz: O'g'rilar bolani qo'yib yuborish uchun katta tovon puli talab qilishdi.

definition_en: To make someone feel uninterested because something is dull or repetitive.
example_en: I did not mean to bore you with all these long stories.
example_uz: Sizni bu uzun hikoyalar bilan zeriktirib qo'ymoqchi emasdim.

definition_en: A woman who serves food and drinks to people at tables in a restaurant.
example_en: The waitress brought us the menu as soon as we sat down.
example_uz: Biz o'tirishimiz bilan ofitsantka menyuni olib keldi.

definition_en: A feeling of wanting to hurt, annoy, or upset someone on purpose.
example_en: He did not invite her to the party just out of spite.
example_uz: U ataylab, g'araz niyatda uni bazmga taklif qilmadi.

definition_en: Having good luck or being in a very good situation.
example_en: We were fortunate to find a place to stay during the festival.
example_uz: Festival paytida boshpana topganimizga ancha omadimiz chopdi.

definition_en: To fail to satisfy someone's hopes or expectations.
example_en: I am sorry to disappoint you, but the tickets are all sold.
example_uz: Sizning umidingizni puchga chiqarayotganimdan uzr, lekin barcha chiptalar sotib bo'lingan.

definition_en: A strong alcoholic drink made from grain and flavored with juniper berries.
example_en: They like to mix gin with tonic water for a refreshing evening drink.
example_uz: Ular kechqurun tetiklashtiruvchi ichimlik sifatida jinni tonik bilan aralashtirib ichishni yoqtirishadi.

definition_en: A doctor who is trained to treat people with mental or emotional problems.
example_en: The patient decided to see a psychiatrist to talk about his anxiety.
example_uz: Bemor o'z xavotirlari haqida gaplashish uchun psixiatrga borishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: To shut a door or window with a lot of force and loud noise.
example_en: The wind blows and the door slams shut in the dark.
example_uz: Shamol esib, eshik qars etib yopildi.

definition_en: A type of small shrub with sweet-smelling flowers often planted in gardens.
example_en: The daphne bush in our garden smells wonderful in early spring.
example_uz: Bog'imizdagi dafna butasi erta bahorda juda xushbo'y hid taratadi.

definition_en: To breathe out slowly and loudly because you are tired, sad, or relieved.
example_en: She sighed with relief when she heard the good news today.
example_uz: Yaxshi xabarni eshitgach, u yengil tin oldi.

definition_en: A child who behaves badly and is not disciplined by their parents.
example_en: The spoiled brat screamed until his mother bought him a toy.
example_uz: Ertakoy bola onasi o'yinchoq olib bermagunicha baqirib yig'ladi.

definition_en: Extremely funny and likely to make people laugh a lot.
example_en: We watched a hilarious movie that made us laugh all evening.
example_uz: Biz butun oqshom kulib o'tiradigan juda kulgili kinoni ko'rdik.

definition_en: An area or passage inside a building that leads to other rooms.
example_en: Please leave your wet umbrella in the hallway before coming inside.
example_uz: Iltimos, ichkariga kirishdan oldin ho'l soyaboningizni yo'lakda qoldiring.

definition_en: A series of musical sounds made by bells or a clock.
example_en: The clock chimes every hour to tell us what time it is.
example_uz: Soat har soatda jaranglab, vaqtni xabar beradi.

definition_en: To say hello or welcome someone in a polite and friendly way.
example_en: The teacher stood at the door to greet every student by name.
example_uz: O‘qituvchi eshik oldida turib har bir o‘quvchini ismi bilan kutib oldi.

definition_en: A low, dull sound made when something heavy hits a surface.
example_en: The heavy book fell onto the floor with a loud thud.
example_uz: Og‘ir kitob polga gurs etib tushdi.

definition_en: Extremely bad, unpleasant, or causing great fear and sadness.
example_en: The weather was absolutely dreadful during our entire vacation last week.
example_uz: O‘tgan haftadagi ta’tilimiz davomida ob-havo juda yomon edi.

definition_en: The past participle form of sing, used to describe a performed song.
example_en: The national anthem was sung beautifully by the talented young choir.
example_uz: Davlat madhiyasi iqtidorli yoshlar xori tomonidan juda chiroyli kuylandi.

definition_en: To make low, weak crying sounds because of pain or fear.
example_en: The small dog whimpers whenever he hears loud noises outside the house.
example_uz: Kichkina it uydan tashqarida baland shovqin eshitganda ingillaydi.

definition_en: Committed to something or declared as a fixed state by an oath.
example_en: They have been sworn enemies since they were children at school.
example_uz: Ular bolaligidan beri ashaddiy dushman hisoblanishadi.

definition_en: Having a very good and pleasant flavor.
example_en: You could make this tasty meal for breakfast tomorrow morning.
example_uz: Ertalabki nonushta uchun bu mazali taomni tayyorlashingiz mumkin.

definition_en: A very strong feeling of sexual desire for someone.
example_en: He felt a powerful sense of lust when he saw her.
example_uz: Unga qarab, ko'ngli kuchli ehtirosga to'ldi.

definition_en: A person's sense of self-worth or their own importance.
example_en: Winning the competition was a huge boost for his ego.
example_uz: Musobaqada g'alaba qozonish uning o'ziga bo'lgan ishonchini juda oshirdi.

definition_en: To stop feeling angry at someone who did something wrong.
example_en: She has finally forgiven him for the mistake he made.
example_uz: U nihoyat uning qilgan xatosini kechirdi.

definition_en: Wanting very much to do or have something.
example_en: Stacey is very eager to go cycling with us this weekend.
example_uz: Steysi dam olish kunlari biz bilan velosipedda sayr qilishga juda oshiqmoqda.

definition_en: Having a bad physical reaction after touching or eating a specific thing.
example_en: I cannot stay in this house because I am allergic to cats.
example_uz: Men bu uyda qololmayman chunki mushuklarga allergiyam bor.

definition_en: To give back money that you have borrowed from someone.
example_en: I finally repaid my student loans just before starting my new job.
example_uz: Yangi ishni boshlashimdan biroz oldin talabalik qarzlarimni nihoyat uzdim.

definition_en: The feeling of being thankful for something that you have received or experienced.
example_en: She showed deep gratitude for the support she received during her illness.
example_uz: U o'z kasalligi vaqtida ko'rsatilgan yordam uchun chuqur minnatdorchilik bildirdi.

definition_en: Having or showing very strong feelings or enthusiasm about something or someone.
example_en: He is a passionate supporter of his local football club every season.
example_uz: U har mavsumda o'z mahalliy futbol klubining ishtiyoqli muxlisidir.

definition_en: Long, thin pieces of potato that are cooked in hot oil until they are crispy.
example_en: I ordered a burger and a large portion of fries for lunch.
example_uz: Men tushlikka burger va katta porsiya kartoshka fri buyurtma qildim.

definition_en: Clothes or makeup used to change how you look to hide who you are.
example_en: The spy wore a fake beard as a disguise to avoid detection.
example_uz: Josus tanilib qolmaslik uchun soxta soqoldan niqob sifatida foydalandi.

definition_en: A person who shoots arrows using a bow for sport or in war.
example_en: The archer aimed carefully at the target before releasing the sharp arrow.
example_uz: Kamonchi o‘tkir o‘qni otishdan oldin nishonni diqqat bilan mo‘ljalladi.

definition_en: The quality of not being guilty of a crime or knowing about evil things.
example_en: The young boy showed his innocence by smiling at the dangerous stranger.
example_uz: Yosh bola xavfli odamga qarab kulib o‘zining beguborligini namoyon etdi.

definition_en: A long, high sound made when something old moves or is pressed.
example_en: I heard the loud creaking of the wooden floor in the night.
example_uz: Tunda yog‘och polning qattiq g‘ijirlaganini eshitdim.

definition_en: A person who creates pictures using paint or colors on a surface.
example_en: The famous painter spent many years working on this beautiful landscape portrait.
example_uz: Mashhur rassom ko‘p yillarini ushbu go‘zal manzara suratini chizishga sarfladi.

definition_en: People or countries that help and support each other in a war or struggle.
example_en: The two countries became strong allies during the long and difficult war.
example_uz: Bu ikki davlat uzoq va qiyin urush davrida mustahkam ittifoqchilarga aylandi.

definition_en: A long, flat surface at an airport where aircraft take off and land.
example_en: The plane taxied slowly down the long runway before taking off tonight.
example_uz: Samolyot havoga ko'tarilishdan oldin uzun yo'lak bo'ylab sekin yurdi.

definition_en: The state of being ill or having a disease in your body.
example_en: Many people suffered from sickness after eating the contaminated food at dinner.
example_uz: Kechki ovqatdan keyin ko'pchilik zaharlanib kasal bo'lib qoldi.

definition_en: A small sea creature with a shell that is often eaten as food.
example_en: We ordered a delicious salad that included fresh shrimp and green vegetables.
example_uz: Biz yangi krevetka va ko'katlar qo'shilgan mazali salatga buyurtma berdik.

definition_en: The past tense of tear, meaning to pull something apart or into pieces.
example_en: He tore his favorite shirt while climbing over the old fence.
example_uz: U panjaradan oshib o‘tayotib, sevimli ko‘ylagini yirtib oldi.

definition_en: Not able or likely to cause any damage or injury to anyone.
example_en: That spider looks scary, but it is actually completely harmless to humans.
example_uz: U o‘rgimchak qo‘rqinchli ko‘rinsa-da, aslida odamlar uchun butunlay zararsiz.

definition_en: Very cruel, violent, or aggressive in a way that causes real pain.
example_en: The mailman was frightened by the vicious dog guarding the front gate.
example_uz: Pochta xodimi darvozani qo‘riqlayotgan yovuz itdan qo‘rqib ketdi.

definition_en: A piece of clothing that covers your hand and has separate parts for fingers.
example_en: You should wear a warm glove on each hand during the winter.
example_uz: Qishda har ikkala qo‘lingizga issiq qo‘lqop kiyib yurishingiz kerak.

definition_en: A man who is employed to look after children in their own home.
example_en: They hired a manny to help take the children to school daily.
example_uz: Ular bolalarni har kuni maktabga olib borish uchun erkak enaga yollashdi.

definition_en: To ask someone for something in a very serious and emotional way.
example_en: The young boy begged his mother to let him play outside longer.
example_uz: Yosh bola onasidan tashqarida ko'proq o'ynashga ruxsat berishini iltijo qildi.

definition_en: Wanting more food, money, or power than you really need.
example_en: The greedy man wanted to own all the land in the village.
example_uz: Ochko'z odam qishloqdagi barcha yerni o'ziniki qilmoqchi edi.

definition_en: The flat part of your face between your hair and your eyebrows.
example_en: She felt the child's forehead to see if he had a fever.
example_uz: U bolaning isitmasi bor-yo'qligini bilish uchun uning peshonasini ushlab ko'rdi.

definition_en: A small nut-like seed that grows underground in a hard shell.
example_en: He always liked eating peanuts along with tea before biscuits appeared.
example_uz: U pechenyelar paydo bo'lishidan oldin choy bilan yer yong'oq yeyishni yoqtirardi.

definition_en: To risk money or something valuable on the result of a game or event.
example_en: Mark won half a million dollars gambling on horse races last year.
example_uz: Mark o'tgan yili ot poygalarida qimor o'ynab yarim million dollar yutib oldi.

definition_en: Behaving as if you are more important than other people.
example_en: He made an arrogant assumption that everyone would agree with his plan.
example_uz: U hamma uning rejasi bilan rozi bo'ladi degan manmanlik bilan xulosa qildi.

definition_en: A musician who plays a simple wind instrument like a pipe or flute.
example_en: The piper played a traditional song during the village festival celebrations.
example_uz: Qishloq bayramida naychi an'anaviy kuylardan birini ijro etdi.

definition_en: A movement of the hands or body to express an idea or feeling.
example_en: He made a friendly gesture by waving his hand at the crowd.
example_uz: U olomonga qo'l silkitib, do'stona imo-ishora qildi.

definition_en: The short, sharp sound made repeatedly by a clock or watch.
example_en: The steady ticking of the clock kept me awake all night long.
example_uz: Soatning bir maromdagi tiqillashi butun tun uxlatmay chiqdi.

definition_en: Used after a negative statement to emphasize that something is not true at all.
example_en: I have no doubt whatsoever that he is telling the truth.
example_uz: U rost gapirayotganiga mutlaqo shubham yo'q.

definition_en: To make a large or sudden jump from one place to another.
example_en: The cat prepared to leap across the fence to catch the bird.
example_uz: Mushuk qushni tutish uchun devor oshib sakrashga tayyorlandi.

definition_en: The harsh sound made by breathing loudly through the nose and mouth while sleeping.
example_en: His snoring was so loud that it kept the whole house awake.
example_uz: Uning xurrak otishi shunchalik qattiq ediki butun uyni uygʻotib yubordi.

definition_en: A climbing plant that grows on walls or trees with evergreen leaves.
example_en: The old stone wall was covered in thick green ivy plants.
example_uz: Eski tosh devor qalin yashil pechak bilan qoplangan edi.

definition_en: To take a person away by force, usually to demand money for their release.
example_en: The criminals planned to kidnap the wealthy man for a large ransom.
example_uz: Jinoyatchilar boy odamni katta toʻlov evaziga oʻgʻirlab ketmoqchi boʻlishdi.

definition_en: To hit a surface and move back quickly in the opposite direction.
example_en: The tennis ball bounced off the wall during our practice session.
example_uz: Mashgʻulot paytida tennis toʻpi devorga urilib qaytdi.

definition_en: A type of small horse that is shorter than most other horse breeds.
example_en: The children enjoyed riding a gentle pony at the local farm.
example_uz: Bolalar mahalliy fermada yuvosh poniga minib zavqlanishdi.

definition_en: A man who works in business or has an important job in a company.
example_en: The successful businessman travels to many countries for his important meetings.
example_uz: Muvaffaqiyatli tadbirkor oʻzining muhim uchrashuvlari uchun koʻplab mamlakatlarga sayohat qiladi.
